jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
職務概要:

Red Hat Consulting チームは、東京オフィスに勤務するプロジェクトマネージャーを募集しています。この役職では、担当地域の複雑なプロジェクトを、立ち上げからデリバリー、クローズまで管理します。部門横断的なチームの連携を図り、主要なプロジェクト評価基準を測定するための適切なメトリクスを確立するとともに、コスト、運用予算、人員配置要件、リソース、リスクなど、プロジェクトの経済的側面をすべて定義、管理、レビューします。プロジェクトマネージャーとして、組織のプロジェクト管理規律の確立にも貢献し、Red Hat Services によるプロジェクト管理の基礎、原則、方法論の導入を推進する役割も担います。

主な職務内容:

PMIに基づくプロジェクト管理手法、Red Hat Servicesのプロジェクト管理手法、システムおよびソフトウェア開発、アジャイルやスクラムなど技術的なデリバリーメソッドを統合し、プロジェクトマネジメントを行う。
プロジェクトの計画、スケジュール管理、進捗管理、顧客及び社内への報告を実施する。
プリセールス活動にPMとして参画し、プロジェクトデリバリーが成功するよう、提案書、見積もり、契約書をレビューし、PMとして適切なインプットを行う。
顧客のニーズ、目標を理解し、チームに必要なスキルや経験レベルを考慮し、適切なコンサルタントやアーキテクトをプロジェクトに配置する。
プロジェクトの課題、メンバーの課題を解決するべくチームレベルのコラボレーションを推進する。
プロジェクト上の課題を管理し、顧客マネジメント、コンサルティングマネージャーなどステークホルダーと連携し、解決に向けリードする。
顧客マネジメントとのプロジェクトレビューを実施し、Red Hat の価値を訴求し、プロジェクト拡大・継続に貢献する
顧客の満足を最大化するため、プロジェクト期間中に生じる顧客との期待値ギャップを継続的に確認し、解消をリードする。
プロジェクトメンバーの稼働率管理、プロジェクトのコス管理を行い、収益目標を達成する。

必須スキル:

IT ベースのプロジェクトにおけるプロジェクト管理業務の経験 7 年以上
関連分野の学士号
IT 業界で使用されている特定のプロジェクト管理およびテクニカルデリバリー方法論に関する知識
優れた対人能力、リーダーシップスキル、分析力、ビジネスインサイト
文章および口頭での優れたコミュニケーション能力
プロジェクト管理の認定資格 (あれば尚可)
個人だけでなくチームで働く能力、プロジェクトチームと各貢献者を動機付ける能力と対立を調停する能力
ネイティブレベルの日本語会話力とビジネスレベルの英語力

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Spanish)
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Project Manager, you are the foundation of our delivery team, focusing on mid-sized technical projects. You provide critical visibility, service reviews, and reporting throughout the implementation lifecycle. You are a professional who moves fast to discover simpler ways to deliver results for our customers while adopting a deeply "Customer-Centric" mindset.

WHY THIS ROLE?

Impact: Own and manage the operational relationship with assigned clients, ensuring their applications scale to meet business needs.
Growth: This "Journey-Level" position provides a clear path toward advanced project management by mastering "zero-surprise" reporting.
Innovation: Work with bleeding-edge data warehouse technology in a truly disruptive software environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Project Governance: Maintain project documentation and track task effort in Smartsheet or Certinia.
Work Structures: Create granular Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and associate effort and resource naming to specific tasks.
Meeting Leadership: Lead internal and client meetings with thorough documentation and rigorous follow-up.
Conflict Management: Navigate internal resource conflicts effectively to keep projects on track.
Success Metrics: Maintain project margins within +/- 5% of target and achieve CSAT scores greater than 4.0.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

Typically 2-5 years of field experience in a services delivery or technical implementation role.
Bachelor’s degree required.
Proficiency in SQL basics, JIRA/Confluence, and fundamental Snowflake architecture.
SnowPro Core (required within 60 days of hire).
Fluent in Spanish (regional requirements)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Banking Software
jobs.description:
We enable financial institutions to become AI-first digital leaders.

As a professional team of global scale, we work with the best clients for great and exciting projects, in an environment where we learn amazing things every day. Each code, each voice, each contribution, each challenge, each success is celebrated here.

We welcome candidates who share our values, have the skills and are passionate to enjoy our journey to build the digital future of finance, together.

About the job:

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager experienced in implementing Banking / LOS projects in financial institutions. Ideal candidates must have multiple project experiences along with software development experience in banks and with more than 12 years of experience.

What You Will Be Doing:

Manage end-to-end implementation projects for retail and commercial banking, ensuring solutions meet client needs and business objectives.
Oversee system implementations and integrations, including ProLender, core banking systems, and third-party solutions.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for both retail and commercial banking projects.
Lead cross-functional teams, including business analysts, developers, testers, and vendors, to ensure timely and efficient project delivery.
Monitor and manage project timelines, risks, budgets, and resources to ensure successful outcomes.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations, including AML, CRA forms, and other industry and geo-specific standards.
Address production issues, coordinate enhancements, and ensure post-go-live support.
Provide insights and recommendations for process improvements and adoption of best practices.
Ensure adherence to project governance, compliance, and quality standards throughout the delivery process.
Provide regular updates to senior leadership and clients on project progress, milestones, and KPIs.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the project team.

What We Are Looking For:

At least 12 years of proven experience as a Project Manager delivering LOS and Digital Banking product implementation projects for banking clients.
Hands-on experience managing retail and commercial banking projects.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
Demonstrated ability to manage integrations with systems such as core banking, CRM, and third-party services.
Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills to handle complex projects.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to engage with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
Experience with tools like MS Project, Devops.
PMP, PRINCE2, or Scrum certifications are a plus.
Applicants must be capable of working with international clients (e.g., those based in Canada, Europe, and Australia) and should be flexible in managing their work hours to accommodate remote meetings with clients or on-site teams. These meetings are expected to last up to a maximum of two hours per day.

What we are offering:

Remote Freedom, Your Way:
At VeriPark we believe in the power of talent, no matter where it resides. Design your ideal workspace and achieve the perfect work-life balance.
Performance-Linked Bonus:
Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed! Enjoy a performance-linked bonus as a testament to your dedication!
Rewards Beyond the Job:
Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including Remote Work Support, Health Insurance, Care Program, and Online Psychological Support. We care you!
Birthday Leave, Because You Matter:
We value your special moments! Take the day off on your birthday and treat yourself.
Global Impact, Cutting-Edge Tech:
Immerse yourself in global projects with top-tier clients and stay ahead with cutting-edge technologies. Your skills will shape the future of our industry.
Unleash Your Potential:
Develop yourself with VeriPark Academy opportunities; webinars, and in-house training sessions.
Diverse, Vibrant Community:
Be part of a dynamic environment that values diversity and inclusivity.
Together Culture:
Even in a remote world, we cultivate connections through engaging face-to-face gatherings as well as online fun events. Special information sharing environment where you can update & align yourself.

About VeriPark

We are a global technology company with more than two decades of expertise in the Financial Services industry. Our mission is to enable financial institutions to become digital leaders by delivering world class customer journeys in digital and assisted channels. We develop omni-channel delivery, customer engagement (CRM), branch automation and loan origination solutions based on Microsoft technology (Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform) for banks and insurance companies worldwide.
With offices in 15 countries from North Americover Europe and the Middle East to Kuala Lumpur, our 900+ colleagues are serving customers in more than 30 countries worldwide.
If you like value growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Staff Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility programs for our team and streamline our processes for building great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our program management practices need to scale with it. You will help our Product and Engineering teams develop processes and frameworks for building quality software, while evaluating new technology developments to drive potential features and products.

What You'll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible technical programs in service of our team’s mission of expanding our consumer product suite and platform capabilities.
Coordinate across engineering teams and non-engineering stakeholders through the full program lifecycle to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and propose technical alternatives, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and develop domain and technical knowledge.
Partner with Product and Engineering to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Track progress, resolve dependencies, evaluate risks, and communicate status to upper management and program stakeholders, and engage the program teams to achieve goals.

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.
Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.
Actively mentors and levels up team members.
Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.
Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

As a Project Manager within the Enterprise Applications Business Unit at Datavail you will provide Netsuite project managements services utilizing Asana as the primary task management platform to (1) Ensure customer satisfaction (2) Ensure project healthiness across multiple metrics.

This role is a standalone project manager position managing teams of client that include employees and outside contractors/firms

As a Sr Project Director within the Enterprise Applications Business Unit at Datavail you will lead ERP/SCM/HCM/EPM application consultancy projects at key strategic clients to success, work closely with the technical delivery and account management team to (1) Ensure customer satisfaction (2) Ensure project healthiness across multiple metrics (3) Help sell/position additional work for the company
Develop integrated project plans, act as primary customer contact for projects
Participate in or develop mechanisms for establishing, monitoring and integrating projects
Use various analyses, other performance measures and risk assessments to manage implementations or to recommend change
Negotiate program and project changes and incorporate changes into project change processes to maintain statements of work, cost and schedule baselines. Lead and direct a remote project team to be successful
This position will focus on delivery of solutions inside our Enterprise Applications business unit
Candidates with working knowledge of delivering solutions to clients using one or more of the following; Oracle Cloud ERP/SCM/HCM/EPM , Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Fusion Middleware and related technologies as well as being familiar with both Waterfall and Agile development methodologies
Candidates must have project successes of turning complex business challenges into effective business and technical solutions that provide significant business value to strategic clients

Essential Functions:

Responsible for managing cross-functional projects for clients
Oversee project budget and driving course corrections to maintain such, for items within your control
Able to organize internal business groups to manage and implement projects to scope while managing customer expectations
Simultaneously manage a portfolio of unrelated projects and provide transparency into progress to client and Datavail management
Can tailor a project management approaches to the type/size of project using various techniques including Agile and waterfall
Develop integrated schedule including critical path and ensures assigned resources are executing as planned
Must have the ability to multi task and enhance a team environment
Monitor, track, and control change to the projects through formal change control management of requirements, configuration, performance measures, cost, schedule, program organization structure, and technology environment (release schedules, infrastructure changes, etc.)
Contribute to Datavail PMO standards, processes, and tools to enable continuous improvement across the entire portfolio and PMO team

Education/Experience:

10 or more years Project/Program Management experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
At least 4 years managing ERP/SCM/HCM/EPM projects with in a cloud or on-prem environment
Must have experience and be adept and lead globally sourced project teams as we use a global delivery model
Bachelor's degree, Business or Technical or a related field of study
15+ years professional services experience with leading projects for external or internal customers
PMP or Agile implementation methodology experience

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Hands-on / roll sleeves up work ethic, team player willing to take on work needed for project to succeed, willing to go beyond the project management role if needed (help create documents, presentations, etc.)
Strong leadership skills and the ability to interface and report status with client leadership (C-Suite)
Experience successfully managing implementation projects
Demonstrated ability to manage (lead and direct) and execute projects through application of best practices
Develops solutions to problems of unusual complexity that require a high degree of ingenuity, creativity, and innovation
Develops solutions to unique challenges that may serve as precedent for future decisions
Decision making that has positively affected the financial posture of the company
Able to lead projects from a position of experience and drive successful outcomes
Excellent customer communication skills ERP/SCM/HCM/EPM specific knowledge

Waterfall & Agile Project Methodology Experience Required

ABOUT THE TEAM

Datavail’s Team of Oracle Experts Can Save You Time and Money

As an Oracle Platinum Partner with 17 specializations, we have extensive experience with everything Oracle. Our experts have an average of 16 years of experience. They’ve overcome every obstacle in helping clients manage everything from databases, BI analytics, reporting, migrations, and upgrades to monitoring and overall data management.

You can free up your IT resources to focus on growing your business rather than fighting fires. Our Oracle experts can guide you through strategic initiatives or support routine database management.

Datavail’s Comprehensive Oracle Database Services

Datavail offers Oracle consulting services that allow you to take advantage of all the features of the Oracle database. We can also assist you in designing, implementing, and managing a wide range of Oracle applications.

Oracle Database Managed Services

Datavail’s business focuses on helping you use your data to drive business results through cost-saving services. The success of your business depends on how well you understand and manage your data. Our Oracle managed cloud services give you the power to unleash your organization’s potential. We provide comprehensive and technically advanced support for Oracle installations to ensure that your databases are safe, secure, and managed with the utmost level of care.

Our delivery performance in data management leads the industry. We offer highly trained Oracle database administrators via a 24×7, always on, always available, global delivery model. jobs.title: Project Manager, BDOADVANTAGE
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary:

The Project Manager, BDOADVANTAGE will be an integral team member, primarily focusing on managing technology development projects. While the Product Owner will oversee the technology product, the Manager will ensure the project's overall success from initiation to closure, by ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project management and a clear understanding of both waterfall and agile development methodologies, allowing for a flexible and effective approach to project delivery.

The Project Manager will coordinate with the product management team, software developers and deployment teams to create and implement project plans to assist and guide technology solutions that meet the needs of our stakeholders.

Amsterdam | 32–40 hours per week | Flexible hybrid working

Vivli Europe is looking for an organised, proactive and highly capable Operations & Project Manager
to help build and run a growing European non-profit organisation.

Vivli Europe works to accelerate research and innovation by making health data easier to access and use securely, responsibly and for public benefit. We work with partners across Europe and internationally, including research organisations, public institutions, health data organisations and life sciences companies.

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You will coordinate important projects and stakeholder activities while also ensuring that the practical details are handled effectively. You should be equally comfortable organising a European workshop, maintaining a project plan, preparing materials for a senior meeting and resolving an operational or administrative issue.

Working closely with the Executive Director and external partners, you will have considerable independence and the opportunity to shape how the organisation operates as it grows.

What you will do
Coordinate projects, workplans, timelines, meetings and deliverables.
Track actions, dependencies, risks and deadlines and ensure appropriate follow-up.
Support the organisation’s day-to-day operations and administration.
Coordinate suppliers, contracts, invoices, budgets and routine finance processes.
Organise European meetings, workshops, events and stakeholder activities.
Prepare agendas, briefings, presentations, meeting notes and follow-up communications.
Maintain accurate records, project documentation, trackers and internal systems.
Support grant-funded and collaborative projects, including reporting and partner coordination.
Work with colleagues and external partners across different countries, sectors and organisations.
Identify and implement practical improvements to internal processes and ways of working.
Provide flexible operational and project support where needed in a small and developing organisation.

What you will bring
Relevant experience in project coordination, programme support, operations or senior administration, ideally gained in a complex or international environment.
A track record of independently coordinating multiple activities and following work through to completion.
Excellent organisational skills and close attention to detail.
A practical, resourceful and solutions-focused approach.
The confidence to take initiative, exercise sound judgement and identify what needs to happen next.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
The ability to work independently while building effective relationships with colleagues, partners and senior stakeholders.
Confidence using standard project-management, finance and collaboration tools.
Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. Knowledge of Dutch would be beneficial.
A relevant higher-education qualification or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in a European institution or agency, international non-profit, research organisation, healthcare, life sciences or health data environment would be particularly valuable. Experience supporting EU-funded or multi-partner projects would also be an advantage.
You do not need to meet every desirable criterion. We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate the core capabilities needed for the role and are motivated by Vivli Europe’s mission.

Location and working arrangements
This is a Netherlands-based employment position. Candidates must be legally entitled to work in the Netherlands and able to perform the role primarily from the Netherlands.

The position is offered at 32–40 hours per week (80–100%)
, with the precise arrangement open to discussion.

What we offer
A permanent employment contract.
A gross annual salary of €55,000–€62,500 based on a 40-hour working week
, depending on experience and calculated pro rata for part-time employees.
8% holiday allowance in addition to the gross annual salary.
25 days’ annual leave based on a 40-hour working week, calculated pro rata for part-time employees.
Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
Meaningful work supporting research, innovation and the responsible use of health data.
A varied role with genuine responsibility, autonomy and development potential.
The opportunity to join a European organisation at an early stage and help shape how it grows.
Further details about employment benefits will be provided during the recruitment process.

Please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the role and the relevant experience you would bring to careers@vivli.eu
by Sunday 20 September 2026
.

Applicant information will be used for recruitment purposes and handled in accordance with applicable data-protection requirements. Further information about the processing of applicant data will be provided during the recruitment process.

jobs.description:

26WD99789

Position Overview

As a Senior Program Manager in Go-to-Market Transformation and Programs at Autodesk, you will lead small-to-medium GTM programs end-to-end, or significant workstreams within larger transformation and growth programs. You will translate program objectives into integrated plans, operating rhythms, and clear execution paths that help teams deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders to clarify scope, manage dependencies, surface tradeoffs, and facilitate timely decisions. You will bring structure to ambiguous work, maintain momentum across teams, and ensure risks, decisions, and next steps are visible and actionable. You bring strong program management discipline, sound judgment, and collaborative influence to your work. You are comfortable operating with limited direction on how to execute, while aligning plans and recommendations to GTM priorities and stakeholder objectives.

Location: This position is hybrid/remote and reports to the Senior Manager of GTM PMO.

Responsibilities

Lead small-to-medium GTM transformation and growth programs, or defined workstreams within larger programs, from planning through execution, launch readiness, and stabilization
Develop and own integrated program plans with clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, owners, and measurable outcomes aligned to GTM priorities
Design and manage program governance, operating cadence, and stakeholder forums that create visibility, accountability, and forward momentum within the program scope
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, and Data stakeholders to align plans, manage dependencies, and resolve blockers within scope
Facilitate cross-functional alignment by understanding stakeholder goals, constraints, and incentives, and by connecting the right people to move work forward
Frame decisions clearly with options, tradeoffs, implications, and recommended next steps to enable timely decisions at the appropriate level
Identify and diagnose risks, dependencies, scope tradeoffs, and root causes; propose practical mitigation options and escalate thoughtfully when needed
Create clear, executive-ready program updates, dashboards, and summaries that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and decisions needed
Design change, enablement, readiness, and adoption plans within programs by identifying impacted audiences, sequencing dependencies, and partnering with enablement and change teams
Ensure launch-to-run readiness by defining ownership, support needs, hyper care plans, and post-launch stabilization activities
Apply PMO standards, tools, templates, and best practices consistently while contributing feedback and improvements based on program learnings
Lead workstreams or small teams through ambiguity, model strong program behaviors, and provide peer guidance, feedback, and coaching when appropriate

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years managing cross-functional programs, workstreams, or GTM initiatives with measurable business outcomes
Experience designing and executing integrated program plans, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across multiple stakeholders or functions
Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, organize complex work, manage scope tradeoffs, and convert objectives into clear plans and next steps
Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales, Customer Success, Enablement, Operations, Product, Technology, or related GTM teams to align program objectives and execution plans
Experience facilitating decisions, documenting options and tradeoffs, and preparing clear materials for senior stakeholders
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize inputs from multiple viewpoints into clear recommendations and program narratives
Experience using PMO tools, program trackers, dashboards, and shared documentation to maintain a trusted source of truth
Working knowledge of GTM data, systems, and reporting concepts, with the ability to use data to support program decisions and status reporting
PMP, Change Management, Agile, or related certifications preferred; practical application of program management methods is valued over strict methodology adherence
Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

About The Team

The role will also support the continued evolution of the Repacks program, including expansion into new categories, formats, and operating models. This will require developing expansion strategies, assessing business and customer needs, defining the capabilities required to scale, and building cross-functional support for proposed changes.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong program management fundamentals, product fluency, strategic thinking, and executive communication skills. The ideal candidate understands how product experiences are developed, can navigate complex functional dependencies, and can move ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives toward clear decisions and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Offers and Buybacks Program Leadership

Drive the Offers and Buybacks program across Core and Live Collectibles, coordinating strategy, product development, operational readiness, and go-to-market execution.
Represent the Collectibles business unit in cross-functional discussions, ensuring customer, seller, category, and business needs are reflected in product decisions.
Translate business objectives and customer use cases into clear program requirements, priorities, and success criteria.
Partner with Product to define and advance the Offers and Buybacks roadmap, including near-term capabilities and longer-term program evolution.
Identify the product, policy, legal, trust, financial, operational, and technical dependencies required to launch and scale program capabilities.
Drive alignment and decisions across stakeholders when requirements, priorities, or functional needs conflict.
Establish clear ownership, sequencing, and escalation paths across dependent workstreams.
Support launch readiness, adoption planning, operating processes, and post-launch program improvements.

Partner with Product and functional teams to clarify requirements, document business use cases, and identify gaps in proposed solutions.
Build and manage integrated program plans covering product development, policy, operations, trust, legal, finance, marketing, and seller readiness.
Surface dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and unresolved decisions early, with clear recommendations for resolution.
Ensure product capabilities are designed to support both Core and Live Collectibles use cases where appropriate.
Help functional partners understand the broader business context, intended customer experience, and strategic importance of the program.
Maintain alignment between business priorities, product roadmaps, functional capacity, and launch timelines.

Repacks Strategy and Category Expansion

Support the continued evolution of the Repacks program across Collectibles.
Develop strategies for expanding Repacks into new categories, formats, seller models, and customer experiences.
Evaluate expansion opportunities based on customer demand, seller capabilities, category dynamics, operational complexity, and business impact.
Define the product, policy, trust, operational, and go-to-market capabilities required to support new Repacks use cases.
Build business cases and strategic narratives that clearly explain the opportunity, requirements, risks, and recommended path forward.
Partner with Category, Product, Live, Trust, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders to gain support for proposed program expansions.
Help move Repacks initiatives from early concept through stakeholder alignment, pilot development, launch, and broader scaling.
Represent the business unit’s perspective while balancing customer experience, seller needs, trust considerations, and marketplace outcomes.

Program Execution and Delivery

Lead 1–3 low- to mid-complexity programs or interconnected workstreams, ensuring end-to-end delivery.
Build and manage program plans, timelines, dependencies, decision points, and launch milestones.
Track risks, actions, decisions, and open issues, ensuring they are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Drive operating cadences, including weekly working sessions, leadership updates, decision forums, and launch-readiness reviews.
Establish clear roles and responsibilities across teams and ensure owners understand their commitments.
Maintain momentum across workstreams by identifying blockers, clarifying next steps, and driving teams toward decisions.
Define program goals and success measures and partner with relevant teams to monitor progress and outcomes.
Support planning cycles, roadmapping, prioritization, and resource-alignment discussions.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Alignment

Coordinate across Business, Product, Engineering, Live, Trust, Legal, Policy, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Category teams.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, governance models, and communication plans.
Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on objectives, requirements, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
Build productive relationships with partners who may have different priorities, incentives, or operating processes.
Navigate ambiguity and cross-functional complexity while maintaining focus on intended business and customer outcomes.
Facilitate discussions that help teams evaluate trade-offs, resolve disagreements, and make timely decisions.
Influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.

Executive Communication and Influence

Create executive-ready presentations, business cases, strategy documents, and program readouts.
Communicate program progress, decisions, dependencies, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
Translate complex product and functional topics into concise narratives tailored to business and executive audiences.
Develop strategic recommendations that connect customer needs, program capabilities, and business outcomes.
Support weekly and monthly business reviews and other leadership forums.
Build stakeholder trust through structured, transparent, and proactive communication.

Operational Excellence

Develop and improve program management frameworks, governance models, documentation, and decision-making processes.
Drive consistency in program planning, dependency tracking, risk management, and execution standards.
Create scalable operating processes that support program launches and ongoing business operations.
Identify opportunities to improve cross-team efficiency, ownership, and accountability.
Document key requirements, decisions, processes, and program learnings to support future expansion.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Serve as the day-to-day program lead for Offers and Buybacks across Core and Live Collectibles, driving progress across strategy, product development, operational readiness, and launch execution.
Represent the Collectibles business unit in Offers and Buybacks product discussions, ensuring buyer, seller, category, and business needs are translated into clear requirements and priorities.
Partner closely with Product to define use cases, clarify requirements, shape the roadmap, and identify gaps in proposed solutions.

Support the continued evolution of Repacks, including strategies for expansion into new categories, formats, and seller models.
Translate Repacks expansion opportunities into clear business requirements, cross-functional workstreams, and stakeholder decisions.
Maintain momentum across all workstreams by resolving blockers, clarifying next steps, and ensuring owners follow through on actions and decisions.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Staff Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility programs for our team and streamline our processes for building great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our program management practices need to scale with it. You will help our Product and Engineering teams develop processes and frameworks for building quality software, while evaluating new technology developments to drive potential features and products.

What You'll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible technical programs in service of our team’s mission of expanding our consumer product suite and platform capabilities.
Coordinate across engineering teams and non-engineering stakeholders through the full program lifecycle to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and propose technical alternatives, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and develop domain and technical knowledge.
Partner with Product and Engineering to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Track progress, resolve dependencies, evaluate risks, and communicate status to upper management and program stakeholders, and engage the program teams to achieve goals.

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.
Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.
Actively mentors and levels up team members.
Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.
Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 10

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 - $255,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics establishes and leads the data governance, reporting, and analytics strategy for Global Program Controls. This role is accountable for ensuring that portfolio delivery data is consistently defined, accurately maintained, appropriately governed, and translated into actionable insights for senior leadership.

As the recognized subject matter expert for program data and performance reporting, this individual will define the policies, standards, operating mechanisms, and analytical capabilities that enable trusted decision-making across the global portfolio. The role owns the authoritative delivery data framework, executive portfolio dashboards, operational reporting suite, data quality program, stewardship network, and reporting calendar.

This position operates across multiple organizations and systems, including Jira, Primavera Cloud, Apex, Unifier, financial platforms, and business intelligence tools. The Senior Program Manager will influence senior leaders, program controls teams, technology partners, finance organizations, and functional stakeholders to establish consistent data practices and improve portfolio visibility.

The successful candidate combines deep expertise in data governance, business intelligence, and program controls with strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership. This is a highly influential individual contributor role that leads enterprise-scale programs and processes through expertise, partnership, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Strategy and Leadership

Establish and lead the Global Program Controls Data Governance program, including its strategy, policies, standards, operating model, controls, and performance measures.
Develop the overarching data governance policy framework and ensure alignment with enterprise data, security, compliance, and technology requirements.
Define decision rights, ownership models, escalation paths, and governance forums for portfolio delivery data.
Advise leadership on data governance, reporting strategy, analytical capability, and portfolio performance measurement.
Evaluate emerging technologies, governance practices, and analytical approaches that can improve data quality, accessibility, automation, and decision-making.
Lead complex, cross-functional data initiatives that span multiple organizations, regions, business processes, and technology platforms.

Data Standards, Dictionary, and Lineage

Lead development and maintenance of the authoritative data dictionary for delivery data across Jira, Primavera Cloud, Unifier, financial systems, and reporting platforms.
Define standard business terms, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, source-system ownership, and acceptable-use requirements.
Establish and maintain data lineage documentation that maps data from source systems through integrations, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.
Ensure that key portfolio metrics have documented definitions, accountable owners, approved sources, and transparent calculation logic.
Resolve conflicting definitions and promote consistent use of data and metrics across teams and regions.

Data Quality and Issue Resolution

Define and enforce data quality rules for completeness, validity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
Establish scheduled data quality monitoring, automated validation checks, exception reporting, and data quality scorecards.
Create measurable data quality targets and communicate trends, gaps, and risks to leadership and data owners.
Operate the data issue resolution process, giving stakeholders a clear mechanism to report suspected data defects.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action efforts for recurring or high-impact data issues.
Partner with system owners and business teams to address upstream process weaknesses rather than relying solely on downstream corrections.
Ensure executive and operational reports are validated for accuracy and completeness before distribution.

Master Data and Data Stewardship

Govern critical master and reference data, including canonical site names, project identifiers, regional hierarchies, organizational structures, program classifications, and reporting dimensions.
Establish and manage a cross-functional data stewardship network.
Identify data owners and stewards within each functional area and define their responsibilities, decision authority, and expected service levels.
Provide training, guidance, tools, and ongoing support to data stewards and contributors.
Facilitate governance forums that address data quality, definition changes, ownership gaps, and cross-system alignment.
Mentor peers and stakeholders on governance, reporting, data interpretation, and analytical best practices.

Executive Reporting and Analytics

Own the strategy, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the global portfolio executive dashboard and operational reporting suite.
Translate complex program, schedule, cost, risk, and workflow data into clear, visually compelling insights for vice presidents and other senior leaders.
Establish reporting standards covering templates, visualization conventions, metric definitions, validation protocols, version control, distribution, and retention.
Manage the reporting calendar and ensure reports are produced, reviewed, approved, and distributed according to established cadences.
Respond to ad hoc leadership requests for custom analysis, scenario evaluation, and portfolio deep dives.

Systems and Data Partnerships

Partner with systems integration, data engineering, IT, and application teams to ensure reliable and scalable data flows.
Define business requirements for integrations, data models, reporting layers, controls, and workflow enhancements.
Partner with system owners to align data access policies with role-based access, confidentiality, security, and business requirements.
Assess the downstream reporting and governance impact of system, process, and data-model changes.
Ensure analytical products draw from governed, traceable, and trusted data sources.
Drive adoption of reusable data products and self-service reporting capabilities while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

Stakeholder Leadership and Influence

Build and maintain a broad network across Global Program Controls, delivery organizations, finance, IT, data engineering, system administration, and senior leadership.
Lead through influence across teams where formal authority may not exist.
Communicate recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing requirements, definitions, or priorities.
Represent Global Program Controls in enterprise data, reporting, and technology forums.
Provide coaching and mentorship to analysts, program managers, data stewards, and other peers across the line of business.
Foster inclusive collaboration by ensuring relevant stakeholders are represented in governance, reporting, and decision-making activities.

Responsibilities

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience leading data governance, analytics, business intelligence, program controls, or enterprise reporting in a complex global environment.
Demonstrated experience building or significantly maturing a data governance or enterprise reporting program.
Expert knowledge of at least one relevant specialist area, such as data governance, business intelligence, program controls, data management, or portfolio analytics.
Deep understanding of:
Data quality management
Master and reference data management
Data lineage and metadata management
Data ownership and stewardship
Metric governance
Reporting controls
Analytical data modeling

Expert proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard design, semantic or data modeling, calculated measures, and report distribution.
Strong knowledge of program controls and performance metrics, including schedule variance, cost variance, forecast accuracy, service-level performance, and earned value.
Experience extracting, interpreting, reconciling, or reporting data from Primavera P6 and Jira.
Experience defining executive dashboards and translating complex data into concise, decision-oriented narratives.
Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and cross-functional teams across organizational boundaries.
Ability to lead multiple complex initiatives with significant business impact, ambiguity, and interdependencies.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and enterprise reporting or analytics platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting construction, capital programs, infrastructure delivery, or data center development.
Familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK or comparable data governance frameworks.
Experience with Unifier, or similar capital project management systems.
Knowledge of financial reporting, including budget-versus-actual analysis, cash-flow forecasting, and cost forecasting.
Experience partnering with data engineering teams on integrations, transformation logic, data warehouses, or semantic reporting layers.
Experience implementing automated data quality monitoring or governance workflow tools.
Familiarity with predictive analytics, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning applications for program controls and portfolio management.
Experience operating in a large, globally distributed enterprise environment.

Key Partners

Global Program Controls leadership
Systems Integration and Data Engineering
Program and Project Controls teams
Reporting and Analytics teams
Root Cause Analysis leaders
Functional and regional pillar leads
Data owners and data stewards
Information Technology and enterprise data teams
Finance and business operations
Scheduling, cost management, risk, and delivery organizations

Scope and Impact

Serves as the recognized subject matter expert for data governance, analytics, and portfolio reporting within the line of business.
Leads strategies, programs, and operating processes that have a material impact on portfolio visibility, data trust, and leadership decision-making.
Advises senior leadership on decisions involving data strategy, performance measurement, governance, systems, and reporting.
Leads work that spans multiple functions, systems, organizations, and geographic regions.
Addresses complex and ambiguous problems by examining systemic causes, applying industry best practices, and introducing innovative or non-conventional approaches.
Regularly contributes to strategic planning and decision-making for Global Program Controls.
Establishes scalable capabilities that improve how the organization manages data, measures performance, identifies risk, and executes its global portfolio.

Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.

Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.

At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.

We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom & judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.

Roles And Responsibilities

Effectively manage cross-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.
Help teams prioritize tasks to focus on the critical activities that drive progress and avoid being sidetracked by less important issues.
Collaborate with the cross-functional teams to ensure the right people are updated with the right information at the right time on status and ensure that cross-product dependencies are understood, planned for, and crisply executed
Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
Function as a primary point-of-contact for stakeholders across the org.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

8+ years of program & project management experience.
Must have a bachelor’s degree. 6+ years with a Master’s degree.
Must include hands-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices from a software/digital side.
Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations

Required Education And Training

Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.
Naturally accountable and responsible; self-starter, self-motivated, self-directed, self-sufficient.
Outstanding communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, to all levels of an organization.
Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer-focused approach
Proven ability to influence at various levels and drive conflict resolution with low drama
Certification in project management (PMP, CSM) desired

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

The Role

As a Program Manager in AMD's AI engineering division, you will oversee end-to-end delivery of cutting-edge AI/ML software stacks for AMD teams. You will explore the potential of open-source software to address real-world challenges and collaborate with product management, customers, software and hardware engineering teams, quality assurance, and operations within a rapidly expanding team. Additionally, you will gain exposure to state-of-the-art AI/ML models in diverse fields, including AI engineering, Large Language Models, and Agentic AI workflows.

The Person

The ideal candidate for this role will be a proactive, enthusiastic, and quick-learning individual passionate about emerging technologies. As a results-driven, adaptable problem-solver, they will thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively navigating ambiguity and change. Leveraging their engineering background and demonstrated success in software delivery, the successful candidate will possess exceptional communication skills, engaging with key stakeholders at all levels – from driving technical conversations to leading executive program reviews.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with engineering managers, software developers, and product managers to drive the planning and execution of multiple dynamic software development projects
Define, plan, and execute projects and program plans based on management guidance and senior technical mentorship
Assess the technical feasibility of new products by clarifying and analyzing requirements with software/hardware architects, technical leads, and engineers
Develop program schedules, considering various software stack components and hardware/firmware dependencies, and build staffing plans to support the timeline
Participate in creating project plans and schedules; develop and improve processes for tracking projects and risk mitigation
Deliver on all assigned program commitments from inception through execution within schedule, budget, and scope
Act as a critical liaison between R&D and other partners for successful project execution
Own resource tracking, status reporting, and issue communication to key partners, including senior executives and customers
Prepare and deliver project status updates and reviews to internal stakeholders
Investigate technical aspects of the program and drive details within firmware, compiler, runtime, tools, and application development teams
Lead across cross-functional teams, including business units, engineering organizations, and finance/operations
Collaborate closely with engineering counterparts across global sites to plan and align operational efficiencies

Preferred Experience

Industry experience in project management
Excellent presentation and leadership skills, able to lead technical discussions
Strong interpersonal skills
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Experience leading complex, interrelated projects, programs, and functions
Outstanding team player, dedicated to meeting deadlines in a fast-paced, multitasking environment
Customer-facing experience is a plus
Familiarity with managing Linux and Windows-based products is beneficial
Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, and MS Office
Experience delivering software for new hardware products such as accelerators and GPUs is advantageous
Experience with AI/ML and Generative AI is required
Familiarity with open-source development and GitHub
Experience with virtualization frameworks (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
Software development & deployment experience

Academic Credentials

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer/Electrical Engineering

LOCATION
: Austin, Tx

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Meta Product Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring people (and businesses) closer together at a global scale. Product TPMs work at the cross-section between technical execution and business strategy and are expected to partner closely with Engineering and Product teams. Being a TPM at Meta means driving impact by delivering measurable results across a wide range of areas. You'll be responsible for defining and guiding high-level goals and roadmaps, monitoring and communicating progress, and defining functional requirements for new products and features. It also means having a strong technical background, understanding system architecture, and the experience to effectively collaborate across functions and organizations to deliver impact.You will be influencing technical strategy and driving execution on the company-wide platforms and services that are used across Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, and Reality Labs. Teams span across Ads, Business Integrity, Commerce, Business Messaging, Privacy, Social Impact, Central Integrity, Growth, Central Metrics, Internationalization, Platforms for Family of Apps, Groups, Search, Foundation, Infra, the Metaverse, and more. This posting represents different full-time roles across the company.

Technical Program Manager Responsibilities:

Develop and manage end-to-end technical product solutions and ensure on-time delivery
Manage cross-functional products and programs in a matrix organization
Help define the roadmap and long-term strategy of the teams that you are working with
Design measurements to track impact and drive internal process improvements
Articulate the technology, requirements, goals and milestones of your team
Collaboratively define the vision for building Meta-scale, state-of-the-art, global products
Develop and manage end-to-end project plans to ensure on-time delivery, provide day-to-day coordination, and quality assurance for tasks
Identify dependencies and develop mitigation strategies
Move fast in a flat organization by working in concert with technical program managers and engineers across Meta to establish a shared vision for improving execution and build solutions for privacy and security at scale
Ongoing communication of planning, project status, issues and risks in a timely fashion to stakeholders
Build bridges with product and infrastructure teams to discover adoption challenges, champion purpose use development and privacy/security product adoption
Help drive product decisions to align with higher company initiative
Bring a strong sense of execution and ownership to the team
Establish shared goals with product teams across the company to build alignment across multiple cross-functional teams and to build and scale products for Meta

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor of Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience
7+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, hardware engineering, or technical product/program management experience
Experience delivering tech programs or products from inception to delivery
Knowledge of user needs, gathering requirements, and defining scope
Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams, demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
Communication experience and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products
Organizational, coordination and multi-tasking experience
Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
Experience establishing work relationships across multi-disciplinary teams and multiple partners in different time zones
Experience working with product teams to build and deliver end-to-end customer focused products with technical knowledge of the underlying platforms and technologies

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

$140,000/year to $198,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. jobs.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Chief Information Officer

What You Will Be Doing

Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination within IT-InfoSec team, AI initiatives and cross-functional teams.
Create program charters, establish roles and timelines, develop communication strategies, and define success metrics for security and AI initiatives
Create and maintain program-level visibility across risk areas, security milestones, and cross-org dependencies—ensuring outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality.
Facilitate collaboration and Communicate status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and drive cross-functional execution with urgency and care.
Manage security control rollouts and migrations, like endpoint hardening, centralised networking etc, that require careful change management across organizations.
Maintain structured communication across program stakeholders
Identify operational gaps and opportunities for improvement and propose solutions to implement.
Improve processes that support security program execution
Assist in defining program milestones and success criteria

What You Will Bring To ChargePoint

Strong track record coordinating business, IT, security, infrastructure, and engineering teams.
Experience driving program governance, RAID management, dependency tracking, and program status reporting.
Experience with at least one of the domain: GRC, Application Security, Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Product Security, AI governance, ITSM.
Experience with creating OKR and business aligned dashboards for leadership visibility
Experience with project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, etc.
Have experience driving cross-functional projects, building longer-running programs, and interfacing with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated capability to work effectively in global, cross-functional teams and collaborative environments across time zones.
Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.

Requirements

8+ years of experience, including Project execution experience in cyber security-related initiatives.
Self-motivated, structured, results-driven; capable of setting priorities and managing time effectively in demanding settings.
Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
CISM, PMP, PgMP, CSM, ACSM or SAFe certification is plus
Have strong interpersonal skills that enable you to influence without authority, build cross-organizational support, cooperation and action around security initiatives, policies and procedures.

Location

Bangalore/ Gururam/ Remote – India
