jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Foundations Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services, as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!

Foundations Engineering is the horizontal on which DoorDash's entire product engineering org runs. It's made up of four pillars: Core Infrastructure
, Developer Platform
, Data Engineering
and Data Platform
. Every product team at DoorDash - consumer, merchant, Dasher, logistics, commerce - builds on top of Foundations.

About The Role

Our team is seeking a Technical Program Manager for Foundations Engineering to drive critical initiatives across Data Engineering, Data Platform, Core Infrastructure, and Developer Platform. This role will involve working with cross-functional teams to establish the vision, strategy, and technical direction for our foundational engineering efforts. Programs in this space will require a strong technical understanding, cross-organization coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralized Technical Program Management team in Engineering and must be located in either the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, or Seattle.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because...

Own Foundations Programs — Partner with Directors in Foundations Engineering and key engineering leaders to define vision, strategy, technical direction, and success metrics for foundational programs. Focus areas include quality, reliability, security, compliance, capacity planning, vendor and cost management, platform adoptions, and migrations.
Drive Platform Adoption — Own the end-to-end motion of getting product engineering teams onto new platform capabilities. This means building migration frameworks, managing long-tail onboarding, removing blockers, and tracking adoption with rigor.
Demonstrate Technical Depth — Develop a full understanding of our technical stack and interdependencies. Contribute meaningfully to design reviews, identify cross-cutting risks, and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and efficient. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being built and why.
Influence Without Authority — Foundations programs require alignment across dozens of product engineering teams that have their own roadmaps and priorities. You'll need to build trust, make compelling cases for platform investment, and navigate organizational complexity to get things done.
Nurture Stakeholders — Manage expectations from engineering leadership down to individual teams. Strong problem solving and negotiation skills are essential. You'll earn trust through competence, not just coordination.
Plan & Execute Optimizations — Drive Engineering OKR planning, develop execution and tracking frameworks, and provide visibility into resource allocation and prioritization across the Foundations portfolio.
Manage Process & Timelines — Maintain timely, succinct communication to leadership and across teams. Build lightweight processes that increase velocity — not processes for the sake of process. DoorDash moves fast; your job is to make it easier to move, not harder.

We're Excited About You Because...

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of recent experience as a Technical Program Manager at a technology company, ideally in an infrastructure or platform engineering organization.
Strong understanding of modern engineering practices, infrastructure systems, and developer tools. Experience with data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering teams to implement data and infrastructure technologies and drive adoption across product and platform engineering teams.
Project planning and execution skills, including reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.
Pragmatic and detailed approach with a focus on progress, not perfection.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Principal - Software Development
jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Enterprise Technology (ET), where we’re developing the digital infrastructure needed to build the road to space, with an emphasis on digital capabilities required to advance Blue Origin’s mission. Enterprise Technology is the center of excellence for digital technology at Blue Origin, providing oversight and governance to align technology and business strategies.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate the release and deployment of large-scale systems to a variety of operational sites. You will manage internal and external stakeholders across engineering, supply chain, safety, operations, launch, maintenance, and corporate functions. You will be well-versed in all aspects of the systems you are responsible for, acting as a technical subject matter expert in support of cross-team collaboration efforts. You will track and report to executive audiences. As a Principal TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop plans, schedules and documentation to satisfy complex integration requirements and deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

In this role you will partner with strong technical leaders to drive the long-term vision of the organization, own delivery of cross organization initiatives, assist in developing and leading organization roadmaps, driving efficiency in processes, and delivering on goals. You understand, utilize and share program-management best practices. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to AOP narratives, and ownership of one or more organizational goals. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you are accountable to the overall strategy as well as driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver. You can define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set goals, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the systems in your product or program space, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind architectural choices.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Job Responsibilities

Analyze product and technology service strategy and make strategic recommendations.
Coordinate the design, development, testing, and deployment of features into production across multiple technical teams.
Create and track project milestones, risks, and dependencies, and describe, own, and prioritize all technical requirements associated with delivery.
Dive deep to understand the design details of the systems in your area, especially those related to customer interfaces and the expectations for system dependencies.
Identify which existing systems or services require changes to implement new capabilities, and work with the SDM for each system to estimate the work involved.
Own the implementation plan across teams and report on progress against technical milestones to stakeholders.
Understand the significant business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind decisions.
Demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate.
Be data-oriented, regularly review metrics, and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility.
Keep programs aligned with organizational goals.
Align stakeholder needs while driving mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions.
Partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine which projects move forward and in what sequence.
Write effective narratives and program updates, and present them effectively to stakeholders and the management team.
Create plans with clear, measurable success criteria and return on investment, while overseeing the gap between teams, processes, and system architectures.
Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks.
Help teams and the organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood/documented, ineffective cross-team collaboration, long-term impacts from the use of third-party technologies, APIs not protected/hardened, insufficient testing/gaps in QA).
Apply organizational expertise, excellent communication skills, leadership skills, and a commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
10+ years of technical product or program management experience working directly with software engineering and technology development teams
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Desired

5+ years of program management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
3+ years of software development experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Proven track record of delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives while managing multiple competing priorities.
Excellent understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
Experience with Confluence, JIRA
Experience with data analysis to capture, process, and organize data to uncover actionable insights.

WA applicants is $169,624.00 - $237,473.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.

You'll help translate business strategy into execution by guiding integrated product teams through the product development lifecycle while balancing customer expectations, financial performance, and technical requirements.

Your ability to manage stakeholders, influence teams, and drive disciplined program execution will directly contribute to product launches, business growth, and continuous improvement across the Hydrostatics portfolio.

What You’ll Be Doing

As Program Manager, you'll own program execution from concept through launch while ensuring alignment across global stakeholders and functional teams.

Lead low to medium complexity programs, including new product development, localization, manufacturing footprint, and cost reduction initiatives, with full accountability for scope, schedule, cost, quality, and delivery.
Develop and manage integrated project plans, budgets, resource requirements, risk registers, and execution strategies to achieve program objectives and business outcomes.
Drive effective collaboration across global cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and timely resolution of project risks and issues.
Monitor project financial performance and lifecycle costs, including development, product, and capital investments, while supporting strong business case execution.
Ensure compliance with Danfoss product development processes, stage-gate requirements, and governance standards through regular reporting and performance reviews.

You'll also play a key role in presenting project status to senior leadership, supporting business proposals, and driving continuous improvement in program management practices.

Essential Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
8-10 years of professional experience, including a minimum of 6 years in product development, program management, or project leadership within hydraulics, industrial products, or a related engineering industry.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and managing product development programs across multiple stakeholders and locations.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, new product development processes, project planning, budgeting, risk management, and project execution methodologies.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Microsoft Project, combined with strong communication and presentation skills.

PMP® or CAPM® certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI) is highly desirable.

Experience working within a Program Management Office (PMO), leading globally distributed teams, and managing complex product development projects will be an advantage.

Knowledge of hydraulic products, manufacturing processes, cost-down methodologies, and value engineering initiatives would strengthen your profile.

to lead the FUSION
program in support of the National Ground Intelligence Center (NGIC) Forces Directorate
. Manage cost, schedule, performance, staffing, quality, security, and deliverables in accordance with contract requirements.

Experience implementing secure generative AI, machine learning, or human‑machine teaming capabilities.

And we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders
who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.

Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.

Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites
Fluency in Japanese (written and verbal)

Preferred Experience

Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance as stipulated by DCSA Assessment and Authorization Process Manual (DAAPM), Joint SAP Implementation Guide (JSIG), and/or National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) regulations
Direct leadership or project/program management experience
IAM Level I certification (Security+ or other)
Relevant Experience Considered:
Cybersecurity, systems security or hardening
Information Technology
Compliance-based auditing using the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and/or non-defense regulations such as FAA, Payment Card Industry (PCI), ISO 9001 Quality Management standards, or HIPPA
Experience working with and/or supporting computer technologies (such as: databases, operating systems, computer network hardware, software programs, hardware troubleshooting or electronics)
Physical security/security, policework/criminal justice, investigations, or Border Patrol
Project or program management, office management, senior administration, or account management

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Criminal Justice, Business or other relevant degree

Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to provide Cemetery Enterprise Application Support (CEAS) across the evolving Cemetery Management suite of cloud applications. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in project management, IT systems supporting federal operations, AWS cloud migration, and Department of Defense compliance requirements.

Essential Functions, Responsibilities & Duties may include, but are not limited to:

Responsibilities

The Senior Project Manager will provide project management support to implement the goals of the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) operations and management for cemetery management systems. This role is critical to managing the development and operations of IT-based systems that conduct cemetery operations for Arlington National Cemetery. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Lead program management support across the evolving Cemetery Management suite of cloud applications
Manage and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO) projects and initiatives for cemetery operations IT systems
Chair and facilitate the Change Control Board (CCB) and Enterprise Architecture Governance Board (EAGB)
Align IT investments with strategic goals and objectives as outlined
Develop and implement project plans containing tasks and milestones to allow for efficient planning and budgeting for IT solutions
Coordinate inter-agency activities with external cemetery stakeholders

Oversee development and maintenance of Department of War (DoW) Authority to Operate (ATO) authorization packages
Provide program-level planning, operations and maintenance, and migration support for cemetery business systems
Ensure strict adherence to specifications given the special significance and attention that national and post cemeteries receive
Support the implementation and sustainment of business processes
Ensure compliance with DoW regulations and requirements
Oversee and establish business processes in alignment with DoD Architecture Framework (DODAF)
Develop, implement, and maintain operational plans for cemetery management systems
Provide strategic planning support to OCIO leadership
Prepare and deliver status reports, briefings, and presentations to government leadership
Lead change management and governance initiatives

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, Information Technology, or related field from an accredited college or university; or 10 years of experience in the related field
Minimum of 10 years of progressive project management experience
Minimum of 5 years of experience with IT systems in a federal government environment
Direct experience with AWS cloud migration projects
Demonstrated experience coordinating with cArmy Enterprise Cloud Management Agency (ECMA)
Proven experience with Department of War (DoW) Authority to Operate (ATO) process and authorization packages
Experience managing IT systems that support critical operational processes and data management
Knowledge of DoD and Army IT policies, directives, and standards
DoD Approved 8140/8570 baseline certification (Security+, CISM, CISSP, or equivalent) – must obtain within six (6) months from date of award if not currently certified

Ability to obtain and maintain Secret clearance

jobs.title: Project Manager – IT Infrastructure Delivery
jobs.description:
Job Description

Project Manager zodpovídá za řízení projektů v oblasti IT infrastruktury, zahrnujících návrh, implementaci a změny síťových řešení, serverových platforem, storage, virtualizace a datových center. Klíčovým aspektem role je zajištění bezpečnosti infrastruktury, souladu s ISMS a uplatňování principů kybernetické bezpečnosti napříč celým životním cyklem projektu.

Role zahrnuje koordinaci technických týmů, řízení dodavatelů, kontrolu harmonogramu a rozpočtu a zajištění souladu s ITIL procesy a bezpečnostními standardy organizace. PM řídí projekty od architektonického návrhu a plánování, přes implementaci a migrace až po předání do provozu a stabilizaci služby s důrazem na bezpečnost, dostupnost a integritu systémů.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Plánování a řízení projektů v oblasti IT infrastruktury (network, servery, storage, virtualizace, DC).
Zajištění implementace bezpečnostních principů
Koordinace interních technických týmů (infrastruktura, bezpečnost, provoz) a externích dodavatelů.
Řízení infrastrukturních změn, migrací, konsolidací a modernizací prostředí se zohledněním kybernetických rizik.
Identifikace a řízení bezpečnostních rizik
Dohled nad souladem řešení s ISMS (např. ISO 27001), bezpečnostními politikami a regulatorními požadavky.
Zajištění souladu s ITIL procesy (Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Capacity, Availability Management).
Řízení rizik, závislostí a dopadů na dostupnost služeb (HA/DR, business continuity).
Aktivní komunikace se zákazníkem, řízení očekávání a reporting stavu projektu (KPI, SLA, bezpečnostní ukazatele).
Řízení předání řešení do provozu včetně bezpečnostní dokumentace a auditní připravenosti.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

jobs.description:
Why We Exist

The world is moving away from rigid ownership models in favour of more flexible, affordable access. Yet the $1.5 trillion device market has barely moved.
Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused — creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.

What We've Built

Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.
We have over $90m ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews.
For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.
Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.
The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.

How We Work

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.
Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.
At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.
We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this?
The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement.
We hire to a high bar. You’ll work with people who push you, raise your game and expect you to do the same. We want every person at Raylo to do the best work of their lives, and enjoy doing it.

Our Core Values

💡 Be deeply curious
– We thrive on innovation through diverse approaches, views, and people.
👟 Walk in your customer’s shoes
– To build the best products and make the best decisions for the long term, we must figure out what our customers need, not just what they want.
🎯 Focus and execute
– We have a big vision, but we believe in nailing the most important problems first.
💥 Be gritty
– Only gritty teams succeed. Our individual ownership, passion, and perseverance mean we’re a team through thick and thin.

Your Team

As a senior leader within Raylo's Risk Operations team, you will report to the Head of Collections & Risk Ops. You will lead the growth of our fraud, credit, and insurance operations as we scale for international expansion. In this hands-on position, you will directly lead a team of Risk Operations Team Leads, who in turn manage our Risk Operations Associates. Your role will involve close internal collaboration with Risk Strategy and broader Operations leadership, alongside managing external relationships with Credit Rating Agency (CRA) contacts and fraud data partners.
We are intentionally focusing this hire on individuals with robust fraud investigation experience and a proven track record of people leadership, rather than a background heavily centered on KYC or underwriting. You will guide the function through a pivotal period of transformation. You will play a central role in shaping the future of Risk Operations at Raylo. This includes driving our organisational redesign, transitioning to a 24/7 rota, evolving our fraud detection, and laying the groundwork for our scaling into new markets

What You’ll Do

Oversee risk operations
- Lead the team in managing fraud investigations, insurance claims, and onboarding referrals, ensuring compliant and high-quality decision-making.
Grow and mentor the function
- Directly manage Team Leads to build capability, succession, and high performance across the wider Risk Operations team.
Deliver insight to leadership
- Provide weekly reporting on fraud, insurance, and referrals to keep senior stakeholders informed.
Lead cross-functional initiatives
- Partner closely with Risk Strategy and Operations leadership on shared priorities and process improvements.
Evolve detection strategy
- Refine prevention techniques by leveraging automation and AI-driven insights.
Shape the Risk Ops org redesign
- Play an active role in the team's move to a 24/7 rota and wider structural changes.
Support Raylo's US market launch
- Contribute research, playbooks and ways-of-working documentation as we prepare to enter the US market.
Stay hands-on
- Get stuck into core casework yourself, not just delegate, especially in your first few months.
Build external relationships
- Partner with CRA contacts and fraud data partners to strengthen our risk decisioning.

You’ll Succeed with

5-7+ years' relevant experience
- proven track record in fraud prevention or risk management within FCA-regulated consumer finance/fintech, including direct people leadership experience.
Proven, direct people management experience
- you actively want to lead and grow a team, not just execute individually.
Confidence owning multiple functions at once
- fraud, insurance and referrals - and building process rather than just following it.
A strong analytical mindset
- comfortable self-serving data; experience with tools such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or similar data/BI platforms is a plus but not essential.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
, enabling you to produce clear reporting for senior leadership and run cross-functional meetings.
Genuine Values fit
- something we look for from the very first conversation.
Problem-solving and adaptability
- you'll thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic environment where new fraud threats emerge regularly.

We’re not looking for you to meet every point on this job description. Please still get in touch if you think you could add value and do your best work here at Raylo. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Opportunities & Benefits

🚀 Fast-track your career – 40% of our employees are promoted every review cycle (bi-annually)
📱 Exclusive Raylo device lease for employees
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 Stock options for all employees
📚 L&D budget to support the skills you value
🏢 Hybrid working model– 4 days in the Belfast Office, 1 day work from home.
🌴 33 days off, your way – 25 days + 8 bank holidays with full flexibility to use on the days that mean the most to you
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption or shared parental leave, if you've been with us for 12 months.
🧸 Workplace nursery scheme for major cost savings

Hiring Process

We move quickly and we'll aim to give you the best candidate experience possible. It starts with a 15-minute call - no prep needed. If there's a fit, we move fast, every stage has a purpose, and we'll tell you what we're looking for at each one.

If there's anything we can do to support you through the process, whether that's adjustments or anything else, please let us know.

*As an FCA-regulated business, we conduct background checks (DBS and AML) on all successful candidates who are offered a position at Raylo during the onboarding process.
Diversity & Inclusion at Raylo

At Raylo, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, believing they make us stronger.

Axelor is a global leader in open-source enterprise software, delivering an all-in-one platform that seamlessly integrates ERP, CRM, and Business Process Management (BPM). Built on a modern, low-code architecture, our solution empowers organizations to customize, automate, and scale their business operations with unmatched flexibility and transparency.
As we expand our international footprint, we are seeking an ambitious, client-focused Project Manager
to join our team in Toronto
and drive high-impact software deployments across North America.
The Role

As Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end software implementations, taking ownership of customer engagements from initial scoping to final delivery. Following an intensive onboarding program on our platform and technology ecosystem, you will serve as the strategic liaison between our clients and internal engineering, functional, and sales teams.
Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Scoping:
Lead functional discovery sessions, analyze complex client workflows, and define detailed functional/technical specifications.
Project Delivery & Governance:
Build project plans, establish scope baselines, manage delivery schedules, and track key milestones across the project lifecycle.
Risk & Change Management:
Proactively identify project bottlenecks, manage scope changes, build risk mitigation plans, and realign resources to keep deployments on schedule.
Cross-Functional Leadership:
Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developers to ensure technical alignment, quality deliverables, and seamless client handoffs.
Client Advocacy:
Maintain clear project communication, lead recurring steering committee reviews, and foster strong, long-term relationships with key customer stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

Experience:
3–5+ years of project management experience leading complex B2B enterprise software deployments (ERP, CRM, or BPM platforms strongly preferred).
Technical Aptitude:
Comfort navigating modular software architectures, enterprise data workflows, and dynamic software integration projects.
Methodologies:
Strong command of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery frameworks; experience managing time-and-materials or fixed-fee projects.
Communication:
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills—able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for executive stakeholders.
Language:
Professional fluency in English is required; fluency in French is a strong asset given our international teams.

What We Offer

Growth:
Opportunity to shape Axelor's growing North American presence within a high-growth tech environment.
Impact:
Direct influence over platform implementation strategies for mid-market and enterprise clients.
Culture:
Collaborative, transparent work culture with flexible working arrangements in Toronto.

About Us

At Lemon Platypus, we help small and medium-sized businesses take the hassle out of HR systems — from choosing the right tools and setting them up properly, to providing ongoing support when it's needed. We work with platforms like HiBob, Employment Hero, and Rippling, and we're proud to be a certified HiBob implementation partner. We're a small, close-knit team, and we care about doing this properly: no cutting corners, no leaving clients to figure it out on their own.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Project Manager to bring structure and momentum to how we deliver HR systems implementations for our clients. You'll be the person keeping multiple projects on track at once — clear on where each one stands, what's coming next, and what needs to happen to get there. This is a hands-on role: you won't just be reporting on progress, you'll be driving it.

What You'll Be Doing

Systems & Process Oversight
Keeping a clear, up-to-date view of every implementation project we're running or planning
Helping us document and continually improve how we run implementations — from discovery through to go-live and hypercare.
Sequencing projects sensibly so our team's time and our clients' expectations are always aligned

Partner & Vendor Coordination
Communicating milestones clearly to the partners and vendors involved in each project

Chasing outstanding items so they don't quietly become blockers

Team Capacity
Keeping an eye on who's working on what across the team, and flagging early if something's going to be a stretch
Helping us plan resource sensibly across concurrent projects

Project Controls
Making sure every project starts with a proper plan, clear scope, and defined success criteria
Keeping the basics in place — status updates, risk logs, change control — and making sure they're actually used, not just written down
Reporting on how things are going, honestly and clearly, so nothing comes as a surprise

Solid project management experience, ideally across multiple concurrent workstreams
Comfortable working directly with external partners and vendors, not just internal teams
Naturally organised — you like things written down and tracked, not just remembered
Experience in HR systems/HRIS projects is a big plus, but not essential if you've got strong transferable PM experience
Clear communicator, calm under pressure, good at chasing without being a nag

A focused team where your work is visible and valued
Variety — no two client projects look the same
The chance to shape how we run project delivery, not just fit into an existing process

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

The Airtel Money Project Manager will 'own and drive' the end-to-end delivery of business, technology and integration projects across Airtel Money.
This is not a project tracking or coordination only role. The Project Manager is expected to have sufficient technical understanding to engage confidently with engineering teams, identify gaps, challenge plans and estimates, facilitate technical problem solving and drive stakeholders towards timely decisions and delivery.

The role requires a highly assertive and outcome-oriented individual who can work across teams without direct authority.

The Project Manager must be comfortable engaging and escalating to senior leadership, including CXOs, whenever intervention or a decision is required to protect the project outcome.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Ownership

Own projects from initiation through requirements, solutioning, development, integration, SIT, UAT, security assessment, operational readiness, go live and post production stabilization.
Establish a clear project scope, delivery plan, milestones, success criteria, governance structure, RACI and stakeholder accountability.
Drive all participating teams to deliver their commitments within the agreed timelines and quality standards.
Ensure that project plans are realistic, dependency linked and supported by clear owners and committed dates.
Identify slippages and delivery risks early, rather than waiting for milestones to be missed.
Develop and drive recovery plans for delayed or at-risk projects.
Take ownership of overall delivery outcomes, including areas dependent on other Airtel teams, OpCos, banks, partners or vendors.
Drive go-live readiness and ensure all business, technical, security and operational prerequisites are completed before launch.
Track post-go-live issues through stabilization and formal closure.

Technical Delivery Leadership

Understand the proposed solution, integration flows, technical dependencies and implementation approach.
Engage confidently with engineering, architecture, testing, security, operations and partner technology teams.
Drive technical discussions relating to APIs, web services, middleware, databases, application platforms, infrastructure and security.
Review technical plans, interface specifications, testing coverage and deployment dependencies with the relevant teams.
Challenge engineering teams constructively on feasibility, estimates, timelines, quality, risks and unresolved dependencies.
Facilitate troubleshooting of API, integration, environment and deployment issues, ensuring that the right technical teams collaborate until resolution.
Be capable of interpreting API responses, logs, error messages, XML/JSON payloads and basic database or Unix/Linux outputs.

Driving Stakeholders and Decisions

Act as the single delivery focal point for assigned projects.
Establish clear ownership and accountability across teams.
Follow through assertively on commitments and challenge missed timelines, unclear ownership or incomplete deliverables.
Identify decisions required and ensure that they are taken at the appropriate level without avoidable delay.
Escalate confidently and constructively to senior management, including CXOs, when decisions, prioritisation or intervention are required.
Present escalations with a clear articulation of the issue, business impact, options, recommendation, owner and decision required.
Resolve conflicts across teams while keeping the overall project objective and Airtel’s interests at the centre.
Build strong working relationships without compromising delivery accountability.

Risk and Dependency Management

Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies.
Maintain an accurate RAID log with clear impact, mitigation, ownership and closure dates.
Provide early-warning communication where timelines, scope, quality or business outcomes are at risk.
Anticipate cross-team, cross-platform and partner dependencies and incorporate them into the project plan.
Drive mitigation and contingency actions instead of limiting the role to risk reporting.
Escalate unresolved risks before they become delivery failures.

Governance and Communication

Establish effective working level and management level governance for every project.
Maintain accurate project plans, schedules, RACI, RAID logs, decision logs and action trackers.
Ensure that project management tools reflect the correct and current status of each project.
Provide concise, factual and transparent status updates, without masking delivery risks or delays.
Prepare and present project status, risks, recovery plans and decisions required to senior management.
Adapt communication according to the audience, from technical teams to business leaders and CXOs.

Continuous Improvement

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and effectively prioritise competing demands.
Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks and recommend improvements to processes, governance and ways of working.
Promote disciplined project-management practices across internal teams and external partners.
Share learning and reusable practices across projects.

Required Skills and Competencies

Strong end to end technology project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross functional teams without direct authority.
Strong technical understanding of APIs, web services, application platforms and system integrations.
Working knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, Unix/Linux, databases, Java-based applications, Kubernetes and information security.
Ability to understand technical discussions, ask the right questions and challenge engineering teams constructively.
Experience in testing, troubleshooting and debugging APIs and integration issues.
Strong ownership mindset with a bias towards action and resolution.
Assertive communication and the ability to hold stakeholders accountable.
Confidence and executive presence to engage with senior management and CXOs.
Ability to escalate constructively, supported by facts, impact assessment and recommended actions.
Strong problem solving, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to remain effective under pressure and during short delivery timelines.
Strong skills in MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to work across diverse cultures, countries and time zones.
Willingness to support critical deployments outside normal business hours and travel at short notice.
Mobile money, payments, fintech, banking or telecommunications experience is preferred.
French language capability would be an advantage.
Agile or SAFe knowledge would be an advantage.

Educational Qualifications and Experience

BE/BTech, MCA, MTech or an equivalent technology-related qualification.
A recognised project-management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
6–10 years of overall experience, including at least 4 years managing technology integration projects.
Experience delivering projects involving engineering teams, business stakeholders, external partners and technology vendors.
Experience in mobile money, digital payments, banking, fintech or telecommunications would be strongly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Projects are delivered within committed scope, timelines and quality standards.
Risks and dependencies are identified and acted upon before they cause delays.
Teams have clear ownership, commitments and accountability.
Technical issues are understood and driven to resolution quickly.
Decisions and escalations are raised at the right level and at the right time.
Senior stakeholders receive accurate information, clear options and actionable recommendations.
Projects go live with appropriate business, technical, security and operational readiness.
The Project Manager is recognised as the end-to-end delivery owner—not merely the custodian of the project plan.

Description

Job Title:
Contract Senior Intelligence Analyst

Required Security Clearance
: TS/SCI

Location:
National Ground Intelligence Center (NGIC) – Charlottesville, VA

Position Overview

Leidos is seeking a Senior Intelligence Analyst
to serve as the FUSION program’s principal contractor authority for analytic tradecraft, methodology, rigor, and finished‑intelligence quality
. This senior leader will guide analysts in selecting and applying appropriate methods, conduct final contractor reviews prior to Government submission, mentor the analytic workforce, and help integrate AI‑enabled analytic tools
into production while preserving objectivity, transparency, sourcing discipline, and human judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as the senior contractor advisor for analytic tradecraft, methodology, rigor, and finished‑intelligence quality.
Guide analysts in applying structured analytic techniques, quantitative methods, qualitative methods, and advanced analytic tools.
Review contractor intelligence products prior to Government review to ensure they fully address customer requirements.
Train and mentor analysts on analytic standards, production processes, and effective human‑machine teaming.
Evaluate and guide responsible use of AI—including generative AI—in analytic research, production, and quality control in accordance with U.S. Government policy.

Specific Duties

Participate in project kickoffs, analytic design reviews, and in‑progress reviews to establish sound methodology throughout the product lifecycle.
Review analytical design worksheets and advise analysts on methods, assumptions, sourcing, and limitations.
Track contractor finished‑intelligence production and identify risks to quality, schedule, or customer responsiveness.
Conduct final contractor review for grammar, clarity, logic, sourcing, classification, metadata, analytic standards, and compliance with the NGIC Product Review Guide.
Assess whether intelligence products clearly answer customer questions and distinguish facts, assumptions, judgments, and uncertainty.
Provide training, coaching, and mentorship to new and experienced analysts.
Serve as the contractor technical representative for tradecraft, methodology, analytic quality, and assessment production.
Evaluate AI‑assisted analytic approaches for suitability, transparency, bias, reliability, sourcing, and security.
Ensure AI‑generated or AI‑assisted content is validated by qualified analysts and complies with ICD 203, ICD 206, classification guidance, and Government policy.

Basic Qualifications

Current Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility at time of hire.
Ability to work full‑time on‑site at NGIC in Charlottesville, VA, beginning Day 1.
Ability to comply with all security, intelligence‑oversight, information‑handling, and training requirements.
Master’s degree in intelligence studies, national security, international affairs, data analytics, or related field.
Twenty (20) years of progressively responsible intelligence‑analysis experience supporting DoD or IC missions.
Minimum five (5) years serving as a senior intelligence analyst, analytic methodologist, tradecraft lead, branch‑level reviewer, or equivalent analytic leader.
Extensive experience producing and reviewing all‑source finished intelligence.
Demonstrated expertise applying IC analytic standards, structured analytic techniques, and appropriate quantitative/qualitative methods.
Experience mentoring analysts and conducting formal product reviews for rigor, sourcing, classification, and customer relevance.
Strong working knowledge or training in AI‑enabled analytic tools, generative AI, data analytics, or human‑machine teaming.

Preferred Qualifications

Certified Defense All‑Source Analysis – Intelligence (CDASA‑I).
Intelligence Fundamentals Professional Certification (IFPC) or comparable IC credential.
Experience supporting NGIC, INSCOM, DIA, Army G‑2, or other Defense Intelligence Enterprise organizations.
Experience serving as a Government or contractor Senior Intelligence Analyst, analytic methodologist, tradecraft lead, analytic ombudsman, or product‑quality evaluator.
Experience reviewing products against ICD 203, ICD 206, and agency‑specific production guides.
Experience integrating secure generative AI, NLP, machine learning, or advanced analytics into intelligence workflows.
Experience across two or more FUSION mission areas (e.g., GMI, I2, S&TI, GEOINT, SIGINT, OSINT, targeting, watch‑listing, wargaming).

This position is contingent upon contract award and requires full‑time, on‑site support at NGIC. Off‑site work is subject to Government approval.

Koniag Services, Inc., a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Intelligence Analyst to support critical missing persons investigative operations in Nashville, TN. The ideal candidate is a motivated professional with a strong background in intelligence analysis, law enforcement operations, or investigative research, and is passionate about making a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals and families affected by missing persons cases. This position is On-Site in Nashville, TN.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.

Position Description

The Missing Persons Intelligence Analyst will provide analytical support to law enforcement and investigative teams working missing persons cases. The analyst will be responsible for gathering, synthesizing, and interpreting data from a wide variety of sources to assist in locating missing individuals and identifying patterns or trends related to missing persons incidents. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Collect, review, and analyze data from law enforcement databases, public records, social media platforms, and other open-source intelligence (OSINT) tools to support active missing persons investigations.
Develop and maintain detailed case files, analytical reports, and intelligence products to assist investigators and law enforcement partners.
Identify patterns, trends, and associations across multiple missing persons cases to support investigative leads and resource prioritization.
Collaborate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, as well as non-governmental organizations, to share intelligence and coordinate investigative efforts.
Utilize geographic information systems (GIS) and mapping tools to analyze location-based data relevant to missing persons cases.
Monitor and analyze tips, leads, and incoming case information, ensuring timely dissemination to appropriate personnel.
Prepare clear and concise written and verbal briefings, summaries, and analytical products for law enforcement personnel and agency leadership.
Support the development and maintenance of databases and tracking systems related to missing persons cases.
Assist in identifying connections between missing persons cases and potential criminal activity, including human trafficking, exploitation, or other offenses.
Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all applicable laws, regulations, and agency policies regarding sensitive case information.
Participate in case review meetings, task force operations, and interagency coordination efforts as required.
Stay current on emerging analytical methodologies, tools, and best practices in the missing persons and law enforcement intelligence fields.

Demonstrated experience producing written analytical products, reports, or intelligence summaries.

Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize large volumes of data from multiple sources into actionable intelligence.

Exceptional written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS) and mapping software for location-based analysis.
Ability to manage multiple cases and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all analytical work products.
Ability to work collaboratively within interagency and cross-functional team environments.
Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive, confidential, and emotionally difficult case material with professionalism and discretion.
Ability to obtain and maintain a required security or public trust clearance.

Experience working within a federal, state, or local law enforcement intelligence environment.

Experience with data visualization tools such as Palantir, i2 Analyst's Notebook, or similar platforms.

Experience supporting task force operations or multi-agency investigative teams.

Working knowledge of trauma-informed approaches when interfacing with families of missing individuals.

jobs.title: Lead Threat Analyst (Black Lotus Labs)
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Black Lotus Labs has an opening for a Lead Information Security Engineer who will support threat hunting, investigation, and discovery of evolving malicious activity using Lumen’s unique network visibility, analytic platforms, and approved AI-enabled tools. Our global visibility into one of the world’s largest and most interconnected IP backbones, combined with our computing cluster and analytic platforms, presents exciting opportunities to apply machine learning, graph analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to help identify threats across the internet. Black Lotus Labs has detected and disrupted key evolving threats at an internet scale for years.

This position will work alongside Black Lotus Labs advanced security researchers, data engineers, malware reverse engineers, data scientists, and our customers to support investigations into evolving threats using technologies like our Hadoop ecosystem (HBase, HDFS, Spark, Kafka, AirFlow), Elasticsearch and Redis clusters, Docker using Docker Swarm, malware environment, a network of honeypots, and modern AI-assisted research and development capabilities.

This is a close-knit, experienced, amazingly smart team that you can be a part of and help build out. This is a remote/work-from-home opening with requirements for in person collaboration at the customer site as needed in Annapolis Junction, Maryland.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance w/ CI Poly.

Location

This is a hybrid position with customer travel in the MD area approximately 1 to 2 times per week..

The Main Responsibilities

Research attacker tools, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and contribute to analytic approaches that support automated detection.
Work with cyber operators and senior researchers, when requested, to support investigations into cyber threat activity and assist with mitigation guidance.
Support automation of investigations through Python scripting, data analysis, and visualization in Jupyter Notebooks and Grafana.
Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal intelligence teams, law enforcement, and outside groups.
Support customer RFIs on incidents and emerging threats with guidance from senior team members as needed.
Use approved AI-enabled tools to assist with research, coding, data exploration, documentation, and knowledge discovery while validating outputs through sound analytical judgment.
Contribute to repeatable workflows that combine analyst expertise, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities to improve investigative efficiency and analytical quality.

What We Look For In a Candidate

Candidates must effectively communicate complex domain-specific concepts, ensuring clarity for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Familiarity with adversary capabilities, infrastructure, and techniques, with the ability to apply that knowledge in collaboration with supporting teams and partners.
Experience using OSINT methods for investigation, including discovering novel threats in malware repositories.
Scripting experience with Python and familiarity with large-scale or distributed data analysis concepts.
Experience supporting cyber threat hunting, security investigations, or analysis of suspicious activity using structured data sets.
Familiarity with network-based threats and identifying suspicious behaviors from network telemetry.
Strong analytical thinking and ability to quickly pick up new methods, tools and programming languages.
Willingness to learn new cyber threat research tradecraft and apply unfamiliar data sources, investigative methods, analytic tools, and AI-assisted workflows to mission-focused problems.
User-level experience in a Unix-based environment.
Familiarity with extracting data through SQL.
Strong writing skills to assist in documenting findings and sharing knowledge with technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrable knowledge of several of the following areas: cybersecurity concepts, network protocols, firewalls, IDS/IPS systems, cyber threat hunting, malware analysis concepts, cyber threat intelligence, common threat actor TTPs, application security concepts, or cloud security fundamentals.
Ability to develop proficiency in unfamiliar technical domains through foundational analytical skills, self-directed learning, and effective use of AI-assisted research and problem-solving tools.
Ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly to support technical research, analysis, coding, documentation, and report development while maintaining professional skepticism and analytical rigor.
Ability to review and validate AI-generated outputs before using them in analysis, findings, or recommendations.

Candidates may also have the following preferred skills or experience:

Previous work experience with Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community, or other government agencies is preferred.
Hands-on experience with Spark, distributed computing, or large-scale data analysis platforms is preferred.
Experience developing automation and analysis in Python-based environments.
Ability to collaborate with peers and senior team members while developing expertise in new technical topics.
Exposure to generative AI, AI-assisted coding, retrieval-augmented analysis, or agent-based workflows in cyber research, threat hunting, or intelligence production is preferred.

Preferred

Familiarity with analyzing NetFlow data to identify unusual patterns and potential security threats.
Interest in conducting trend analysis to uncover patterns and emerging threats, enabling proactive defense strategies.
Demonstrated curiosity and sound judgment when using AI-enabled tools in mission-focused environments while maintaining data protection requirements, analytical integrity, and human accountability for findings and recommendations.

Use SQL to extract, transform, and manage data from internal sources, ensuring it’s accurate and ready for analysis.
Analyze complex business problems, uncovering trends, root causes, and opportunities to improve performance.
Build and enhance Tableau reports and dashboards, turning data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.

jobs.title: Compliance Program Analyst
jobs.description:
ALTEN Romania
is part of the ALTEN Group, a leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and sustainable technical solutions that meet the needs of our local and international partners.

About the role:

Your focus will be understanding our compliance standards inside and out — and helping the teams around you apply them correctly. This role centers on validating that controls are designed and operating effectively across ITGC, ISP, and QMS domains. You'll test controls, review evidence, facilitate audits, field inquiries, support escalations, and contribute to control design conversations — making sure the right standards are understood, applied, and met. You'll also support Quality Management System (QMS) testing for both Global and Territory-specific controls, including facilitating audit evidence collection, validation, and delivery throughout the year. You'll partner with IT product teams, security, risk management, QMS resource owners, and internal/external auditors — serving as a knowledgeable, responsive resource who helps teams stay compliant and audit-ready.

A typical day might include the following:

ITGC control testing and validation (primary focus)

Develop a deep understanding of the Information Security Policy (ISP) and Controls Standard — and help product and technology teams understand and apply the requirements to their environments.
Test and validate that ITGC controls are designed effectively and operating as intended across key domains — Access Controls, System Development and Change Management, Cyber Security and Data Protection, Service Management, and Resilience.
Validate controls across:
Identity and access management
— confirm that provisioning and de-provisioning, privileged access reviews, segregation of duties, and authentication mechanisms are in place and functioning as required.
Change management
— verify that SDLC controls, change management procedures, emergency change processes, and application development security controls are designed appropriately and operating effectively.
Cyber security operations
— validate that incident management, malware protection, vulnerability and patch management, encryption, certificate administration, and logging and monitoring controls meet ISP requirements.
Database and network controls
— confirm that database configuration and administration, firewall configuration, and system performance monitoring are compliant and evidenced.
Resilience
— validate that business continuity and disaster recovery plans have been tested (at a minimum, annually) and that evidence supports compliance.
Validate that application penetration testing has been performed by independent third parties in accordance with ISP requirements. Review and validate the evidence, ensure it's complete and audit-ready, and provide it in support of audit requests. Escalate any gaps or concerns to the CPL.
Perform compliance checks to assess adherence against the ISP, controls, and relevant standards — reviewing vulnerability scans, security control validations, and other evidence to confirm controls are met.
Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness. Document test results clearly and escalate deficiencies, gaps, or areas of concern to the CPL with practical recommendations.
Support control design conversations with product and technology teams — helping them understand what 'good' looks like and how to meet ISP and ITGC requirements before issues arise.

QMS testing — Global and Territory-specific controls

Perform testing of Global and Territory-specific QMS controls.
Validate control design and effectiveness through walkthroughs, sample testing, and evidence review.
Review QMS documentation and support audit evidence requests.
Collaborate with QMS owners to align testing scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Identify control gaps and findings; provide recommendations for remediation.
Track remediation activities and ensure timely closure of issues.
Monitor regulatory requirements and highlight potential control gaps.
Support QMS reporting and status updates for stakeholders.

Audit facilitation and evidence management

Support internal and external audits (SOC 2, ISO 27001, 7216, internal reviews), coordinating auditor requests and evidence collection.
Review and validate audit evidence, following up with control owners to address gaps.
Maintain audit-ready repositories of evidence, policies, controls, and testing documentation.
Support walkthroughs and access reviews, ensuring teams and documentation are audit-ready.
Act as a key audit contact, coordinating stakeholders and escalating issues when needed.

Inquiries, escalations, and control design support

Provide guidance on ISP, ITGC, and QMS compliance requirements to product teams and stakeholders.
Help teams interpret and implement compliance standards in a practical and effective way.
Support control design activities, including evidence and audit-readiness requirements.
Escalate complex or high-risk compliance matters to the CPL with recommendations.
Track and follow up on inquiries and escalations to ensure timely resolution.

Remediation support and continuous monitoring

Track and support remediation of audit findings, ITGC deficiencies, and QMS control gaps through closure.
Validate completion of remediation actions and escalate overdue or high-risk issues.
Monitor applications and controls to ensure ongoing compliance and early risk identification.
Identify and escalate compliance risks and control weaknesses across ITGC, ISP, and QMS domains.

Stakeholder engagement and communication

Act as a key point of contact for IT, Security, Risk, Product teams, and QMS stakeholders.
Communicate compliance and control requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support compliance awareness and training initiatives across the portfolio.
Respond to stakeholder inquiries and provide accurate compliance-related information.

Reporting, metrics, and data-driven insights

Prepare compliance status reports for the CPL and senior management — covering audit findings, ITGC and QMS control testing results, risk posture, and remediation progress.
Maintain and update compliance dashboards, trackers, and monitoring tools so metrics stay current and actionable.
Use data-driven metrics to evaluate control testing coverage and compliance program effectiveness. Surface insights and improvement opportunities to the CPL.

Policy, procedure, and access review support

Help the CPL review and maintain compliance policies and procedures aligned to ISP, QMS, and regulatory frameworks.
Support and coordinate quarterly and ad-hoc access reviews. Track results, exceptions, and alignment with access control standards.

To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills:

Audit experience
Strong understanding of SOC 2, ISO 27001, and 7216. You've facilitated audits and validated evidence from preparation through remediation.
ITGC and control testing
Demonstrated experience validating ITGC controls — access controls, change management, operations, SDLC, and resilience. You can assess whether controls are designed and operating effectively.
QMS testing
Experience supporting or executing QMS control testing across Global and Territory-specific control frameworks. Familiarity with quality management principles and testing methodologies.
ISP knowledge
Working knowledge of information security policies and control frameworks. You can interpret standards, help teams apply them, and validate compliance.
Risk awareness
Ability to identify and escalate compliance and operational risks within a portfolio context.
Education
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, information security, risk management, or a related field.
Experience
2–4 years in compliance, IT audit, ITGC testing, QMS testing, or risk management — preferably within a regulated IT or product environment.

Technical skills

Proficiency in SOC 2, ISO 27001, 7216, and ISP control frameworks.
Experience with ITGC and QMS testing methodologies — walkthroughs, sample testing, re-performance, and inspection.
Familiarity with vulnerability scanning tools, penetration testing evidence review, and security monitoring.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, evidence management platforms, GRC tools, and compliance reporting and dashboard tools.
Understanding access control systems, identity management, encryption standards, and change management workflows.
Familiarity with Global and Territory-specific regulatory and quality management requirements.

Only eligible candidates will be contacted within a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.

jobs.title: Expert Data Analyst (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind ein führender Anbieter in Europa im Bereich Live Commerce und bieten als Medienplattform die unterhaltsamste Form des Shoppings. Mit unserem kuratierten Produktsortiment aus den Bereichen Fashion, Schmuck, Beauty, Wellness, Haushalt sowie Home & Living begeistern wir täglich eine Vielzahl Zuschauer:innen, Fans und Follower auf allen Kanälen: im TV, im Onlineshop und in den sozialen Medien. Durch die vernetzte Inszenierung von Lifestyle-Themen und Markenwelten sind wir Innovationstreiber für kanalübergreifendes Shopping-Entertainment. Die Kund:innen entscheiden, wann und wo sie bei HSE shoppen.

Das Erwartet Dich

Du analysierst Kunden-, Produkt- und Kanaldaten, um tiefgehende Erkenntnisse über das Kundenverhalten zu gewinnen und datenbasierte Geschäftsentscheidungen voranzutreiben – mit besonderem Fokus auf die digitalen Kontaktpunkte von HSE (E-Commerce-Webshop und native Apps).
Du wandelst komplexe Datensätze in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen um und bist als strategischer Sparringspartner für Stakeholder im gesamten Unternehmen tätig, indem du diagnostische Analysen durchführst.
Du führst explorative Datenanalysen (EDA) durch, um Geschäftshypothesen zu testen und neue prädiktive Variablen für das Kundenverhalten mithilfe von SQL und Python zu identifizieren.
Du unterstützt digitale Teams bei der Validierung ihrer Lösungen durch eine fundierte Planung und Analyse von A/B-Tests, um die Customer Experience zu optimieren und den Umsatz zu steigern.
Du arbeitest mit Data Scientists an Projekten zur Verbesserung des Kundenverständnisses zusammen und bereitest Analytics-Insights vor, die als Grundlage für prädiktive Modelle dienen.
Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reports und Präsentationen für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und stellst sicher, dass alle Erkenntnisse klare Empfehlungen für messbare Geschäftsmaßnahmen enthalten.
Du arbeitest in einem agilen Umfeld und kooperierst mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern (z. B. Marketing, Produktmanagement, Customer Support), um datenbasierte Entscheidungen bei HSE voranzutreiben.

Das Bringst Du Mit

Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Analytics, Marketing, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fachbereich mit starkem statistischem Hintergrund.
Du verfügst über fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics oder Data Science, idealerweise mit mehreren Jahren Erfahrung in digitaler Analytics und E-Commerce-Umgebungen.
Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python zur Analyse großer Datenmengen sowie fundierte Expertise in statistischen Analysen mit Python oder R.
Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Customer Analytics mit (Erfahrung in Product Analytics und/oder Marketing Analytics ist von Vorteil) und verfügst über praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Statistik im Geschäftskontext.
Du hast Erfahrung in agilen Arbeitsumgebungen und überzeugst durch hohe Flexibilität, analytisches Denken, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail.
Du verfügst über starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, analytische Tiefe mit einer klaren Business-Impact-Orientierung zu verbinden.
Du sprichst fließend Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil) und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit einem agilen Mindset sowie Begeisterung für Innovationen.

The Data Analyst
for Value-Based Insights
(VBI) is responsible for transforming Medicare (CMS) claims data into metrics, benchmarks, and measures that power WellSky's VBI product for Home Health and Hospice providers and payers. This role builds and maintains claims-based data extracts and performance measures, translates CMS methodologies and regulatory rules into production analytics, and partners with product and engineering to deliver trusted, data-driven insights. The work is retrospective, methodology-driven, and directly tied to how agencies measure and improve value-based performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Build and maintain claims-based data extracts and measures from CMS data sources, including the Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW) and Limited Data Set (LDS), to support VBI Home Health and Hospice solutions.
Develop and maintain performance measures such as HHVBP claims-based measures, MSPB-PAC, Functional Items, hospitalization/ER/PPH/DTC rates, utilization and efficiency metrics, length of stay, and composite/percentile scores.
Interpret CMS regulations and annual Final Rules (e.g., HHVBP methodology, eTPS calculations) and translate measure specifications into accurate, reproducible SQL logic.
Write and optimize SQL against large claims datasets in BigQuery; contribute to data pipelines, quarterly lookup-table refreshes, and extract automation.
Produce referral pattern, competitive analysis, market/benchmark extracts, and validate outputs against CMS public benchmarks (e.g., Home Health Compare) and client expectations.
Investigate data quality issues and metric discrepancies, and document methodology, data sources, and assumptions so results are auditable and repeatable.
Prepare data for downstream BI/visualization layers (e.g., Sisense) and collaborate with product managers and engineers to define technical requirements and analytical interpretations.
Perform other job duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree in quantitative, health-informatics, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
2–4 years of experience in data analysis, with demonstrated proficiency in SQL against large, complex datasets.
Direct experience working with Medicare/CMS claims data (e.g., CCW, LDS, LDS/RIF files, or comparable claims sources).
Comfort with healthcare claims coding structures (e.g., ICD, HCPCS/CPT, revenue codes, DRGs).
Ability to translate written specifications or methodologies into analytical logic and validate results for accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:    

Knowledge of Home Health and/or Hospice operations, post-acute care, or value-based care programs (e.g., HHVBP, HHVBP eTPS, hospice HIS/HOPE).
Experience with CMS quality/value-based program methodologies and familiarity with reading CMS regulations/Final Rules.
Hands-on experience with BigQuery (or a comparable cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Sisense, Tableau, or Power BI.
Familiarity with risk adjustment or benchmarking concepts.
Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for data transformation and automation.

Job Expectations:

Willing to work additional or irregular hours as needed, particularly around quarterly CMS data refreshes and annual Final Rule cycles.
Must work in accordance with applicable security and HIPAA policies to safeguard company and client protected health information.
Must be able to sit and view a computer screen for extended periods of time.

AXA Japanの経営を支える、バックオフィス部門のデータ&AI利活用を促進できる

データビジネスパートナー部とは、社内の各ビジネス部門のデータ・AI利活用を支援する組織であり、担当するビジネス部門ごとに4つの課に分かれています。単なる要望のヒアリングにとどまらず、データエンジニアリング・データモデリング・セキュリティー・コンプライアンスなどの専門組織と、担当するビジネス部門の間に立ち、双方の「架け橋」としてAXA Japanにおける安全かつ効果的なデータ＆AI利活用の形を具現化するというミッションを持っております。

部内の異動を通じて、営業部門やお客様対応部門など、他のビジネス領域へ挑戦し、保険ビジネス全体のデータ&AI利活用を見渡せる専門性を身につける

<技術専門スキル（Technical Skills）>

必須

IT、データ、またはビジネスアナリシス領域における3〜4年程度の実務経験
