jobs.description:
We're CX fanatics, with technology at the core of everything we do. The world's most-loved brands rely on us to deliver seamless, tech-driven experiences. Now, we're looking for a BI Business Analyst to help transform data into meaningful insights that support better business decisions across Transcom. If you're passionate about data, analytics and creating user-friendly reporting solutions, we'd love to hear from you. Sounds interesting? Apply now!

Join Transcom as a BI Business Analyst!

Be part of our IT team and play a key role in helping Transcom make better use of its data. In this role, you'll work across the BI ecosystem, partnering with business and technical stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to the development of BI standards, data integrations and continuous improvements of our reporting platform. In this role, you will:
Act as a trusted link between clients, business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clear and effective communication
Work with BI users and stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and deliver the best possible reporting experience
Design and recommend BI solutions that balance performance, scalability and cost
Create clear data mappings and communicate findings effectively
Participate in data and reporting solution design, using your understanding of business processes and the Transcom operating model
Analyse reporting data structures and source systems to troubleshoot issues and design effective data processes
Contribute to complex data consolidation projects and data integration activities
Help develop and maintain BI data standards aligned with business requirements and industry best practices

What's in it for YOU!

International and inclusive environment that makes you feel supported, encouraged and welcome from day one
Opportunity to work with data and BI solutions that support decision-making across a global organisation
Continuous development through our internal learning platforms and external training
Hybrid working model
Opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries and cultures
Corporate benefits and discounts

To be successful in this role, the following is needed:

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a STEM discipline such as IT, Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering
Minimum 2 years' experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analysis or a similar domain
Experience with data modeling, data troubleshooting and complex data consolidation projects
Good knowledge of SQL
Experience with creating dashboards and data visualisations is a plus; knowledge of Looker is an advantage
Experience with Cloud platforms; knowledge of GCP is an advantage
Experience with tools commonly used in the CX industry, such as WFM, SAP, Avaya, Salesforce, Genesys or Zendesk, is a plus
Good working knowledge of Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office
Strong analytical, problem-solving and process-driven mindset
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain data and technical concepts clearly to different audiences
Ability to work effectively within a geographically and culturally diverse team
Fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus

Please include a full CV, in English, with your application

Closing date is Thursday 24th September 2026

What Life at Transcom is like!

At Transcom, we're relentlessly committed. To our clients and each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. Taking the potential they have today and turning it into skills for the future. Getting recognised for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. Championing positive, lasting change in their teams and communities. That's just how we are at Transcom. Here we care and root for each other. You're included, just as you are, from day one. And with the right mindset, there's no end to how far we can go together.

jobs.description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Business Intelligence Analyst

Overview

Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most critical water challenges. We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across the business by developing insightful reporting, dashboards, and analytical tools.

This role is ideally suited to a candidate with strong Power BI expertise and a good understanding of finance processes, who can bridge the gap between data, finance, and business performance. The successful candidate will help transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI for finance and business stakeholders.
Partner with FP&A, finance, and operational teams to understand reporting requirements and translate them into effective BI solutions.
Analyse financial and operational performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly performance review processes through robust reporting and insight generation.
Develop and optimise data models, datasets, and reporting structures to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, consistency, and governance.
Automate manual reporting processes where possible to reduce effort and improve timeliness.
Provide variance analysis and ad hoc reporting to support decision-making across the business.
Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned with business definitions and KPIs.
Support continuous improvement initiatives in reporting, analytics, and performance management.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Proven experience in a Business Intelligence Analyst, Reporting Analyst, or similar analytical role.
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, data modelling, DAX, and Power Query.
Experience working with large and complex datasets from multiple sources.
Solid understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and communicate meaningful insights.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting tools and data extraction processes.
Experience working with ERP or finance systems is desirable.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across finance and non-finance teams.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings in a clear and business-friendly way.
Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline preferred.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting finance team in a commercial or industrial environment.
Familiarity with SQL and other data querying / transformation tools.
Experience in data governance, master data, or reporting standardisation initiatives.
Exposure to international or matrix organisations.
Experience in manufacturing, engineering, utilities, or related sectors would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

Data visualisation and storytelling
Commercial and financial acumen
Attention to detail and accuracy
Continuous improvement mindset
Stakeholder collaboration and influence
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

職務概要:

Red Hat Consulting チームは、東京オフィスに勤務するプロジェクトマネージャーを募集しています。この役職では、担当地域の複雑なプロジェクトを、立ち上げからデリバリー、クローズまで管理します。部門横断的なチームの連携を図り、主要なプロジェクト評価基準を測定するための適切なメトリクスを確立するとともに、コスト、運用予算、人員配置要件、リソース、リスクなど、プロジェクトの経済的側面をすべて定義、管理、レビューします。プロジェクトマネージャーとして、組織のプロジェクト管理規律の確立にも貢献し、Red Hat Services によるプロジェクト管理の基礎、原則、方法論の導入を推進する役割も担います。

主な職務内容:

PMIに基づくプロジェクト管理手法、Red Hat Servicesのプロジェクト管理手法、システムおよびソフトウェア開発、アジャイルやスクラムなど技術的なデリバリーメソッドを統合し、プロジェクトマネジメントを行う。
プロジェクトの計画、スケジュール管理、進捗管理、顧客及び社内への報告を実施する。
プリセールス活動にPMとして参画し、プロジェクトデリバリーが成功するよう、提案書、見積もり、契約書をレビューし、PMとして適切なインプットを行う。
顧客のニーズ、目標を理解し、チームに必要なスキルや経験レベルを考慮し、適切なコンサルタントやアーキテクトをプロジェクトに配置する。
プロジェクトの課題、メンバーの課題を解決するべくチームレベルのコラボレーションを推進する。
プロジェクト上の課題を管理し、顧客マネジメント、コンサルティングマネージャーなどステークホルダーと連携し、解決に向けリードする。
顧客マネジメントとのプロジェクトレビューを実施し、Red Hat の価値を訴求し、プロジェクト拡大・継続に貢献する
顧客の満足を最大化するため、プロジェクト期間中に生じる顧客との期待値ギャップを継続的に確認し、解消をリードする。
プロジェクトメンバーの稼働率管理、プロジェクトのコス管理を行い、収益目標を達成する。

必須スキル:

IT ベースのプロジェクトにおけるプロジェクト管理業務の経験 7 年以上
関連分野の学士号
IT 業界で使用されている特定のプロジェクト管理およびテクニカルデリバリー方法論に関する知識
優れた対人能力、リーダーシップスキル、分析力、ビジネスインサイト
文章および口頭での優れたコミュニケーション能力
プロジェクト管理の認定資格 (あれば尚可)
個人だけでなくチームで働く能力、プロジェクトチームと各貢献者を動機付ける能力と対立を調停する能力
ネイティブレベルの日本語会話力とビジネスレベルの英語力

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Staff Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility programs for our team and streamline our processes for building great customer and merchant products. You will help our Product and Engineering teams develop processes and frameworks for building quality software, while evaluating new technology developments to drive potential features and products.

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible technical programs in service of our team’s mission of expanding our consumer product suite and platform capabilities.
Coordinate across engineering teams and non-engineering stakeholders through the full program lifecycle to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and propose technical alternatives, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and develop domain and technical knowledge.
Partner with Product and Engineering to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.
Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.
Actively mentors and levels up team members.
Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.
Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.

The Project Manager oversees multiple mechanical construction projects in the Ottawa area, managing budgets, schedules, and resources to ensure successful delivery. This role works closely with foremen, subcontractors, and vendors to achieve financial and operational goals while maintaining strong client relationships.

Why This Role Matters to Modern Niagara

Project Managers are key to delivering safe, on-time, and on-budget projects. Their leadership ensures client satisfaction, profitability, and alignment with Modern Niagara’s standards, supporting long-term growth and repeat business.

Maintain safety standards across all project activities.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and scheduling software.

Knowledge of basic accounting principles (asset).

Experience overseeing manufacturing project lifecycles.

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Staff Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility programs for our team and streamline our processes for building great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our program management practices need to scale with it. You will help our Product and Engineering teams develop processes and frameworks for building quality software, while evaluating new technology developments to drive potential features and products.

What You'll Do

Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible technical programs in service of our team’s mission of expanding our consumer product suite and platform capabilities.
Coordinate across engineering teams and non-engineering stakeholders through the full program lifecycle to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and propose technical alternatives, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and develop domain and technical knowledge.
Partner with Product and Engineering to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
Track progress, resolve dependencies, evaluate risks, and communicate status to upper management and program stakeholders, and engage the program teams to achieve goals.

What We Look For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.
Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.
Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.
Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.
Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.
Actively mentors and levels up team members.
Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.
Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.
Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 10

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 - $255,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics establishes and leads the data governance, reporting, and analytics strategy for Global Program Controls. This role is accountable for ensuring that portfolio delivery data is consistently defined, accurately maintained, appropriately governed, and translated into actionable insights for senior leadership.

As the recognized subject matter expert for program data and performance reporting, this individual will define the policies, standards, operating mechanisms, and analytical capabilities that enable trusted decision-making across the global portfolio. The role owns the authoritative delivery data framework, executive portfolio dashboards, operational reporting suite, data quality program, stewardship network, and reporting calendar.

This position operates across multiple organizations and systems, including Jira, Primavera Cloud, Apex, Unifier, financial platforms, and business intelligence tools. The Senior Program Manager will influence senior leaders, program controls teams, technology partners, finance organizations, and functional stakeholders to establish consistent data practices and improve portfolio visibility.

The successful candidate combines deep expertise in data governance, business intelligence, and program controls with strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership. This is a highly influential individual contributor role that leads enterprise-scale programs and processes through expertise, partnership, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Strategy and Leadership

Establish and lead the Global Program Controls Data Governance program, including its strategy, policies, standards, operating model, controls, and performance measures.
Develop the overarching data governance policy framework and ensure alignment with enterprise data, security, compliance, and technology requirements.
Define decision rights, ownership models, escalation paths, and governance forums for portfolio delivery data.
Advise leadership on data governance, reporting strategy, analytical capability, and portfolio performance measurement.
Evaluate emerging technologies, governance practices, and analytical approaches that can improve data quality, accessibility, automation, and decision-making.
Lead complex, cross-functional data initiatives that span multiple organizations, regions, business processes, and technology platforms.

Data Standards, Dictionary, and Lineage

Lead development and maintenance of the authoritative data dictionary for delivery data across Jira, Primavera Cloud, Unifier, financial systems, and reporting platforms.
Define standard business terms, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, source-system ownership, and acceptable-use requirements.
Establish and maintain data lineage documentation that maps data from source systems through integrations, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.
Ensure that key portfolio metrics have documented definitions, accountable owners, approved sources, and transparent calculation logic.
Resolve conflicting definitions and promote consistent use of data and metrics across teams and regions.

Data Quality and Issue Resolution

Define and enforce data quality rules for completeness, validity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
Establish scheduled data quality monitoring, automated validation checks, exception reporting, and data quality scorecards.
Create measurable data quality targets and communicate trends, gaps, and risks to leadership and data owners.
Operate the data issue resolution process, giving stakeholders a clear mechanism to report suspected data defects.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action efforts for recurring or high-impact data issues.
Partner with system owners and business teams to address upstream process weaknesses rather than relying solely on downstream corrections.
Ensure executive and operational reports are validated for accuracy and completeness before distribution.

Master Data and Data Stewardship

Govern critical master and reference data, including canonical site names, project identifiers, regional hierarchies, organizational structures, program classifications, and reporting dimensions.
Establish and manage a cross-functional data stewardship network.
Identify data owners and stewards within each functional area and define their responsibilities, decision authority, and expected service levels.
Provide training, guidance, tools, and ongoing support to data stewards and contributors.
Facilitate governance forums that address data quality, definition changes, ownership gaps, and cross-system alignment.
Mentor peers and stakeholders on governance, reporting, data interpretation, and analytical best practices.

Executive Reporting and Analytics

Own the strategy, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the global portfolio executive dashboard and operational reporting suite.
Translate complex program, schedule, cost, risk, and workflow data into clear, visually compelling insights for vice presidents and other senior leaders.
Establish reporting standards covering templates, visualization conventions, metric definitions, validation protocols, version control, distribution, and retention.
Manage the reporting calendar and ensure reports are produced, reviewed, approved, and distributed according to established cadences.
Respond to ad hoc leadership requests for custom analysis, scenario evaluation, and portfolio deep dives.

Systems and Data Partnerships

Partner with systems integration, data engineering, IT, and application teams to ensure reliable and scalable data flows.
Define business requirements for integrations, data models, reporting layers, controls, and workflow enhancements.
Partner with system owners to align data access policies with role-based access, confidentiality, security, and business requirements.
Assess the downstream reporting and governance impact of system, process, and data-model changes.
Ensure analytical products draw from governed, traceable, and trusted data sources.
Drive adoption of reusable data products and self-service reporting capabilities while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

Stakeholder Leadership and Influence

Build and maintain a broad network across Global Program Controls, delivery organizations, finance, IT, data engineering, system administration, and senior leadership.
Lead through influence across teams where formal authority may not exist.
Communicate recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing requirements, definitions, or priorities.
Represent Global Program Controls in enterprise data, reporting, and technology forums.
Provide coaching and mentorship to analysts, program managers, data stewards, and other peers across the line of business.
Foster inclusive collaboration by ensuring relevant stakeholders are represented in governance, reporting, and decision-making activities.

Responsibilities

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience leading data governance, analytics, business intelligence, program controls, or enterprise reporting in a complex global environment.
Demonstrated experience building or significantly maturing a data governance or enterprise reporting program.
Expert knowledge of at least one relevant specialist area, such as data governance, business intelligence, program controls, data management, or portfolio analytics.
Deep understanding of:
Data quality management
Master and reference data management
Data lineage and metadata management
Data ownership and stewardship
Metric governance
Reporting controls
Analytical data modeling

Expert proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard design, semantic or data modeling, calculated measures, and report distribution.
Strong knowledge of program controls and performance metrics, including schedule variance, cost variance, forecast accuracy, service-level performance, and earned value.
Experience extracting, interpreting, reconciling, or reporting data from Primavera P6 and Jira.
Experience defining executive dashboards and translating complex data into concise, decision-oriented narratives.
Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and cross-functional teams across organizational boundaries.
Ability to lead multiple complex initiatives with significant business impact, ambiguity, and interdependencies.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and enterprise reporting or analytics platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.

Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.

At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.

We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom & judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.

Roles And Responsibilities

Effectively manage cross-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.

Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
Function as a primary point-of-contact for stakeholders across the org.

8+ years of program & project management experience.
Must have a bachelor’s degree. 6+ years with a Master’s degree.
Must include hands-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices from a software/digital side.
Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations

Naturally accountable and responsible; self-starter, self-motivated, self-directed, self-sufficient.

Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer-focused approach

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Foundations Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services, as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!

Foundations Engineering is the horizontal on which DoorDash's entire product engineering org runs. It's made up of four pillars: Core Infrastructure
, Developer Platform
, Data Engineering
and Data Platform
. Every product team at DoorDash - consumer, merchant, Dasher, logistics, commerce - builds on top of Foundations.

About The Role

Our team is seeking a Technical Program Manager for Foundations Engineering to drive critical initiatives across Data Engineering, Data Platform, Core Infrastructure, and Developer Platform. This role will involve working with cross-functional teams to establish the vision, strategy, and technical direction for our foundational engineering efforts. Programs in this space will require a strong technical understanding, cross-organization coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralized Technical Program Management team in Engineering and must be located in either the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, or Seattle.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because...

Own Foundations Programs — Partner with Directors in Foundations Engineering and key engineering leaders to define vision, strategy, technical direction, and success metrics for foundational programs. Focus areas include quality, reliability, security, compliance, capacity planning, vendor and cost management, platform adoptions, and migrations.
Drive Platform Adoption — Own the end-to-end motion of getting product engineering teams onto new platform capabilities. This means building migration frameworks, managing long-tail onboarding, removing blockers, and tracking adoption with rigor.
Demonstrate Technical Depth — Develop a full understanding of our technical stack and interdependencies. Contribute meaningfully to design reviews, identify cross-cutting risks, and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and efficient. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being built and why.
Influence Without Authority — Foundations programs require alignment across dozens of product engineering teams that have their own roadmaps and priorities. You'll need to build trust, make compelling cases for platform investment, and navigate organizational complexity to get things done.
Nurture Stakeholders — Manage expectations from engineering leadership down to individual teams. Strong problem solving and negotiation skills are essential. You'll earn trust through competence, not just coordination.
Plan & Execute Optimizations — Drive Engineering OKR planning, develop execution and tracking frameworks, and provide visibility into resource allocation and prioritization across the Foundations portfolio.
Manage Process & Timelines — Maintain timely, succinct communication to leadership and across teams. Build lightweight processes that increase velocity — not processes for the sake of process. DoorDash moves fast; your job is to make it easier to move, not harder.

We're Excited About You Because...

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of recent experience as a Technical Program Manager at a technology company, ideally in an infrastructure or platform engineering organization.
Strong understanding of modern engineering practices, infrastructure systems, and developer tools. Experience with data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering teams to implement data and infrastructure technologies and drive adoption across product and platform engineering teams.
Project planning and execution skills, including reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.
Pragmatic and detailed approach with a focus on progress, not perfection.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Principal - Software Development
new_jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Enterprise Technology (ET), where we’re developing the digital infrastructure needed to build the road to space, with an emphasis on digital capabilities required to advance Blue Origin’s mission. Enterprise Technology is the center of excellence for digital technology at Blue Origin, providing oversight and governance to align technology and business strategies.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate the release and deployment of large-scale systems to a variety of operational sites. You will manage internal and external stakeholders across engineering, supply chain, safety, operations, launch, maintenance, and corporate functions. You will be well-versed in all aspects of the systems you are responsible for, acting as a technical subject matter expert in support of cross-team collaboration efforts. You will track and report to executive audiences. As a Principal TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop plans, schedules and documentation to satisfy complex integration requirements and deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

In this role you will partner with strong technical leaders to drive the long-term vision of the organization, own delivery of cross organization initiatives, assist in developing and leading organization roadmaps, driving efficiency in processes, and delivering on goals. You understand, utilize and share program-management best practices. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to AOP narratives, and ownership of one or more organizational goals. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you are accountable to the overall strategy as well as driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver. You can define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set goals, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the systems in your product or program space, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind architectural choices.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Job Responsibilities

Analyze product and technology service strategy and make strategic recommendations.
Coordinate the design, development, testing, and deployment of features into production across multiple technical teams.
Create and track project milestones, risks, and dependencies, and describe, own, and prioritize all technical requirements associated with delivery.
Dive deep to understand the design details of the systems in your area, especially those related to customer interfaces and the expectations for system dependencies.
Identify which existing systems or services require changes to implement new capabilities, and work with the SDM for each system to estimate the work involved.
Own the implementation plan across teams and report on progress against technical milestones to stakeholders.
Understand the significant business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind decisions.
Demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate.
Be data-oriented, regularly review metrics, and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility.

Our cybersecurity team is seeking a Program Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
to support our team 100% onsite
at our facility in McKinney, Texas.

The Program Information Systems Security Manager
is responsible for compliance oversight, assessment, and operations of systems under their purview. They may be assigned to a single large-scale program or oversee multiple programs.

ISSM also has cognizance of all collateral Classified Information System (CIS) at the Site per Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code as stipulated by various US Government requirements including (but not limited to):

National Industrial Security Operating Manual (NISPOM) and related documentation such as:

Risk Management Framework (RMF),
Baseline Technical Security Configuration Standards,
Defense Counter-Intelligence Security Agency (DCSA)
Assessment and Authorization Process Manual (DAAPM)
Customer/contract specific Cybersecurity regulations.

Components of the cybersecurity (CS) program include Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities (documentation preparation, system configuration/validation, certification testing, etc.), security sustainment activities (hardware change management, software change management, account management, media protection, user interface, file transfers, etc.), conducting self-inspections, and delivering information systems security education and awareness.

You will conduct recurring Cybersecurity reviews on information systems in accordance with DoD Manuals, NIST Special Publications, customer directives, and company policies as applicable.

You are responsible for the execution of the Raytheon Continuous Monitoring Plan as required by CA-2 Security Assessments. You’ll serve as subject matter experts (SME) on a broad range of Cybersecurity topics. You may represent the Cybersecurity organization and business unit to external Cybersecurity counterparts.

What You Will Do

Cybersecurity Site ISSMs are required to maintain IAM Level III certification commensurate with their role as required by DoDD 8140 (8570).
Complete all DCSA and Raytheon GSS required training within 6 months of appointment (annual requirements thereafter).
Accountability for all systems under site CAGE: metrics, eMASS, Raytheon business process (RCAST), Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) as described by Sr. ISSM
Maintaining a working knowledge of all CIS functions, security policies, technical security safeguards, and operational security measures.
Interactions with DCSA SCA/ISSP to track items including, but not limited to, upcoming authorizations (ATO), new technologies solutions (i.e., new SIEM, OS, etc.), policy interpretations (in conjunction with Sr. ISSM), and onsite A&A.
Developing, maintaining, and updating, in coordination with all system stakeholders (CS Manager, ISO, DT, etc.), applicable site POAM(s) to identify system weaknesses, mitigating actions, resources, and timelines for corrective actions.
Coordinating DCSA SVA preparation activities for assigned CAGE in conjunction with site FSO/CS Manager. AS

Important note:
Within six months of hire date, you must obtain and maintain a Security professional certification commensurate with IAM Level III certification commensurate with your role as a Program ISSM as required by DoD 8140 (8570) if you do not already have this certification.

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically a University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years experience.
Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance as stipulated by DCSA Assessment and Authorization Process Manual (DAAPM), Joint SAP Implementation Guide (JSIG), and/or National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM) regulations
Direct leadership or project/program management experience
IAM Level I certification (Security+ or other)
Relevant Experience Considered:
Cybersecurity, systems security or hardening
Information Technology
Compliance-based auditing using the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and/or non-defense regulations such as FAA, Payment Card Industry (PCI), ISO 9001 Quality Management standards, or HIPPA
Experience working with and/or supporting computer technologies (such as: databases, operating systems, computer network hardware, software programs, hardware troubleshooting or electronics)
Physical security/security, policework/criminal justice, investigations, or Border Patrol
Project or program management, office management, senior administration, or account management

Qualifications We Prefer

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Criminal Justice, Business or other relevant degree
Experience with various information system security tools that address vulnerability analysis and mitigation. These may include Splunk, Forcepoint, Ivanti, Tenable, ACAS, HBSS, etc.
Experience in the oversight and execution of the Assessment & Authorization processes (Certification & Accreditation), as defined in JSIG/RMF
Experience in the execution and management of Information System’s (IS) incident response and administrative inquiries/investigations in collaboration with the Investigations department
Experience in and execution of a continuous monitoring/improvement program (to include but not limited to self-inspections, security control assessments, training, log management systems, automated inventory utilities, etc.)
Experience providing technical security expertise and oversight for complex, cross-domain, heterogeneous classified networked environments in collaboration with internal/external Customers, Information Technology (IT) and other Raytheon Business Units
Experience working with the customer, both internal and external in the development of Basis of Estimates (BOE's) and contract negations
Experience with any of the following: NISPOM, JAFAN 6/3, DCID 6/3, JSIG/RMF, and ICD-503 or equivalent requirements to include technical computer/network system auditing
Experience in professional engagements with internal and external customers (i.e., AOs, DAOs, SCAs, Program Managers, etc.), to include negotiating controls/requirements with government Contracting Activities

Role zahrnuje koordinaci technických týmů, řízení dodavatelů, kontrolu harmonogramu a rozpočtu a zajištění souladu s ITIL procesy a bezpečnostními standardy organizace. PM řídí projekty od architektonického návrhu a plánování, přes implementaci a migrace až po předání do provozu a stabilizaci služby s důrazem na bezpečnost, dostupnost a integritu systémů.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Plánování a řízení projektů v oblasti IT infrastruktury (network, servery, storage, virtualizace, DC).
Zajištění implementace bezpečnostních principů
Koordinace interních technických týmů (infrastruktura, bezpečnost, provoz) a externích dodavatelů.
Řízení infrastrukturních změn, migrací, konsolidací a modernizací prostředí se zohledněním kybernetických rizik.
Identifikace a řízení bezpečnostních rizik
Dohled nad souladem řešení s ISMS (např. ISO 27001), bezpečnostními politikami a regulatorními požadavky.
Zajištění souladu s ITIL procesy (Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Capacity, Availability Management).
Řízení rizik, závislostí a dopadů na dostupnost služeb (HA/DR, business continuity).
Aktivní komunikace se zákazníkem, řízení očekávání a reporting stavu projektu (KPI, SLA, bezpečnostní ukazatele).
Řízení předání řešení do provozu včetně bezpečnostní dokumentace a auditní připravenosti.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Prokazatelná praxe v řízení IT infrastrukturních projektů (network, server, storage, DC).
Dobrá znalost principů kybernetické bezpečnosti
Orientace v oblasti ISMS (např. ISO 27001), řízení bezpečnostních rizik a compliance.
Znalost ITIL / ITSM procesů a jejich praktické aplikace.
Zkušenost s řízením změn v prostředí s vysokými nároky na dostupnost a bezpečnost.
Schopnost řídit harmonogram, rozpočet, kapacity a KPI.
Znalost projektových metodik (Waterfall, Agile, hybridní přístup dle typu projektu).
Výborné komunikační a vyjednávací dovednosti (CZ/EN).

Výhodou

Znalost regulatorních rámců (NIS2, GDPR, zákon o kybernetické bezpečnosti apod.).
Certifikace ITIL, PRINCE2, PMI/PMP nebo obdobné.
Zkušenost s projekty zaměřenými na datová centra, cloudové migrace nebo hybridní infrastrukturu.
Znalost oblastí HA/DR, business continuity a kapacitního plánování.

Benefity:

Akciový program
CGI program pomoci
Plně hrazená nemocenská až 30 dní v roce
Bezúročné půjčky
Referral program
Stravenky 140Kč
Životní pojištění
Očkování proti chřipce a klíšťové encefalitidě
Multisport karta
Kafeterie 900Kč měsíčně
Hybridní pracovní model a flexibilní pracovní doba
5 týdnů dovolené + 3 dny sick day
Narozeninové volno a CSR den

A mnoho dalších…

Společně, jako vlastníci, převádíme odborné znalosti do praxe.

Život ve společnosti CGI je založen na vlastnictví, týmové práci, respektu a pocitu sounáležitosti. U nás můžete naplno využít svůj potenciál.

Zveme vás, abyste se od prvního dne stali vlastníky. Společně pracujeme na tom, aby se náš sen stal skutečností. Proto o sobě mluvíme jako o partnerech CGI, a ne jako o zaměstnancích. Těžíme z našeho společného úspěchu a máme možnost a odpovědnost aktivně se podílet na směřování a strategii naší společnosti.

Vaše práce vytváří hodnoty. Budete rozvíjet inovativní řešení a trvalé vztahy s kolegy a klienty a zároveň budete mít přístup ke globálním možnostem, abyste mohli proměnit své nápady ve skutečnost, využít nové příležitosti a těžit z předních odborných znalostí v oboru a technologií.

Budete rozvíjet svou kariéru tím, že se připojíte ke společnosti, která je postavena, aby rostla a přetrvala. Podpoří vás vedoucí pracovníci, kterým záleží na vašem zdraví a pohodě, a kteří vám pomohou využít příležitostí k rozvoji vašich dovedností a rozšíření obzorů.

new_jobs.title: Senior Risk Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Why We Exist

The world is moving away from rigid ownership models in favour of more flexible, affordable access. Yet the $1.5 trillion device market has barely moved.
Our mission is to transform how technology is bought, used and reused — creating better outcomes for customers, brands and the planet.

What We've Built

Raylo is the subscription infrastructure that enables leading electronics brands, including PlayStation, HP and Dyson, to move from one-off device sales to recurring subscription programmes that increase conversion, deepen loyalty and capture more lifetime value.
We have over $90m ARR, we’re profitable, growing fast, with over a quarter of a million subscriptions across consumers and small businesses. Customers trust us too, with a 4.5/5 Trustpilot rating from more than 20,000 reviews.
For customers, the experience is simple: subscribe to a device, get support throughout, upgrade when you want, and return it when you’re done. Behind that sits an AI-powered operating system that executes and manages device subscriptions end to end: credit and fraud decisioning, lifecycle operations, and the financing engine that enables brands to run subscription programmes at scale.
Brands can unlock a powerful new growth engine with Raylo across embedded checkout, Raylo.com and the customer app — converting more DTC customers, reaching subscription-first demand, and driving repeat upgrades that compound customer lifetime value.
The impact of our circular model is big. We cut emissions per device by around 50% compared to buy-and-discard. We’re B Corp certified, backed by Macquarie, NatWest and Channel 4 Ventures, and recognised by Tech Nation’s Future Fifty.

How We Work

AI is changing what small, ambitious teams can build. Companies that embrace it will define the next decade.
Raylo is uniquely placed to benefit. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.
At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.
We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this?
The more we automate, the more human judgement matters. AI gives people back time, and we expect them to spend it on the things no model can replicate: conversations, trust, craft and team judgement.
We hire to a high bar. You’ll work with people who push you, raise your game and expect you to do the same. We want every person at Raylo to do the best work of their lives, and enjoy doing it.

Our Core Values

💡 Be deeply curious
– We thrive on innovation through diverse approaches, views, and people.
👟 Walk in your customer’s shoes
– To build the best products and make the best decisions for the long term, we must figure out what our customers need, not just what they want.
🎯 Focus and execute
– We have a big vision, but we believe in nailing the most important problems first.
💥 Be gritty
– Only gritty teams succeed. Our individual ownership, passion, and perseverance mean we’re a team through thick and thin.

Your Team

As a senior leader within Raylo's Risk Operations team, you will report to the Head of Collections & Risk Ops. You will lead the growth of our fraud, credit, and insurance operations as we scale for international expansion. In this hands-on position, you will directly lead a team of Risk Operations Team Leads, who in turn manage our Risk Operations Associates. Your role will involve close internal collaboration with Risk Strategy and broader Operations leadership, alongside managing external relationships with Credit Rating Agency (CRA) contacts and fraud data partners.
We are intentionally focusing this hire on individuals with robust fraud investigation experience and a proven track record of people leadership, rather than a background heavily centered on KYC or underwriting. You will guide the function through a pivotal period of transformation. You will play a central role in shaping the future of Risk Operations at Raylo. This includes driving our organisational redesign, transitioning to a 24/7 rota, evolving our fraud detection, and laying the groundwork for our scaling into new markets

What You’ll Do

Oversee risk operations
- Lead the team in managing fraud investigations, insurance claims, and onboarding referrals, ensuring compliant and high-quality decision-making.
Grow and mentor the function
- Directly manage Team Leads to build capability, succession, and high performance across the wider Risk Operations team.
Deliver insight to leadership
- Provide weekly reporting on fraud, insurance, and referrals to keep senior stakeholders informed.
Lead cross-functional initiatives
- Partner closely with Risk Strategy and Operations leadership on shared priorities and process improvements.
Evolve detection strategy
- Refine prevention techniques by leveraging automation and AI-driven insights.
Shape the Risk Ops org redesign
- Play an active role in the team's move to a 24/7 rota and wider structural changes.
Support Raylo's US market launch
- Contribute research, playbooks and ways-of-working documentation as we prepare to enter the US market.
Stay hands-on
- Get stuck into core casework yourself, not just delegate, especially in your first few months.
Build external relationships
- Partner with CRA contacts and fraud data partners to strengthen our risk decisioning.

You’ll Succeed with

5-7+ years' relevant experience
- proven track record in fraud prevention or risk management within FCA-regulated consumer finance/fintech, including direct people leadership experience.
Proven, direct people management experience
- you actively want to lead and grow a team, not just execute individually.
Confidence owning multiple functions at once
- fraud, insurance and referrals - and building process rather than just following it.
A strong analytical mindset
- comfortable self-serving data; experience with tools such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or similar data/BI platforms is a plus but not essential.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
, enabling you to produce clear reporting for senior leadership and run cross-functional meetings.
Genuine Values fit
- something we look for from the very first conversation.
Problem-solving and adaptability
- you'll thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic environment where new fraud threats emerge regularly.

We’re not looking for you to meet every point on this job description. Please still get in touch if you think you could add value and do your best work here at Raylo. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Opportunities & Benefits

🚀 Fast-track your career – 40% of our employees are promoted every review cycle (bi-annually)
📱 Exclusive Raylo device lease for employees
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 Stock options for all employees
📚 L&D budget to support the skills you value
🏢 Hybrid working model– 4 days in the Belfast Office, 1 day work from home.
🌴 33 days off, your way – 25 days + 8 bank holidays with full flexibility to use on the days that mean the most to you
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption or shared parental leave, if you've been with us for 12 months.
🧸 Workplace nursery scheme for major cost savings

Hiring Process

We move quickly and we'll aim to give you the best candidate experience possible. It starts with a 15-minute call - no prep needed. If there's a fit, we move fast, every stage has a purpose, and we'll tell you what we're looking for at each one.

If there's anything we can do to support you through the process, whether that's adjustments or anything else, please let us know.

*As an FCA-regulated business, we conduct background checks (DBS and AML) on all successful candidates who are offered a position at Raylo during the onboarding process.
Diversity & Inclusion at Raylo

At Raylo, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, believing they make us stronger.

new_jobs.description:
Role Purpose

The Airtel Money Project Manager will 'own and drive' the end-to-end delivery of business, technology and integration projects across Airtel Money.
This is not a project tracking or coordination only role. The Project Manager is expected to have sufficient technical understanding to engage confidently with engineering teams, identify gaps, challenge plans and estimates, facilitate technical problem solving and drive stakeholders towards timely decisions and delivery.

The role requires a highly assertive and outcome-oriented individual who can work across teams without direct authority.

The Project Manager must be comfortable engaging and escalating to senior leadership, including CXOs, whenever intervention or a decision is required to protect the project outcome.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Ownership

Own projects from initiation through requirements, solutioning, development, integration, SIT, UAT, security assessment, operational readiness, go live and post production stabilization.
Establish a clear project scope, delivery plan, milestones, success criteria, governance structure, RACI and stakeholder accountability.
Drive all participating teams to deliver their commitments within the agreed timelines and quality standards.
Ensure that project plans are realistic, dependency linked and supported by clear owners and committed dates.
Identify slippages and delivery risks early, rather than waiting for milestones to be missed.
Develop and drive recovery plans for delayed or at-risk projects.
Take ownership of overall delivery outcomes, including areas dependent on other Airtel teams, OpCos, banks, partners or vendors.
Drive go-live readiness and ensure all business, technical, security and operational prerequisites are completed before launch.
Track post-go-live issues through stabilization and formal closure.

Technical Delivery Leadership

Understand the proposed solution, integration flows, technical dependencies and implementation approach.
Engage confidently with engineering, architecture, testing, security, operations and partner technology teams.
Drive technical discussions relating to APIs, web services, middleware, databases, application platforms, infrastructure and security.
Review technical plans, interface specifications, testing coverage and deployment dependencies with the relevant teams.
Challenge engineering teams constructively on feasibility, estimates, timelines, quality, risks and unresolved dependencies.
Facilitate troubleshooting of API, integration, environment and deployment issues, ensuring that the right technical teams collaborate until resolution.
Be capable of interpreting API responses, logs, error messages, XML/JSON payloads and basic database or Unix/Linux outputs.

Driving Stakeholders and Decisions

Act as the single delivery focal point for assigned projects.
Establish clear ownership and accountability across teams.
Follow through assertively on commitments and challenge missed timelines, unclear ownership or incomplete deliverables.
Identify decisions required and ensure that they are taken at the appropriate level without avoidable delay.
Escalate confidently and constructively to senior management, including CXOs, when decisions, prioritisation or intervention are required.
Present escalations with a clear articulation of the issue, business impact, options, recommendation, owner and decision required.
Resolve conflicts across teams while keeping the overall project objective and Airtel’s interests at the centre.
Build strong working relationships without compromising delivery accountability.

Risk and Dependency Management

Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies.
Maintain an accurate RAID log with clear impact, mitigation, ownership and closure dates.
Provide early-warning communication where timelines, scope, quality or business outcomes are at risk.
Anticipate cross-team, cross-platform and partner dependencies and incorporate them into the project plan.
Drive mitigation and contingency actions instead of limiting the role to risk reporting.
Escalate unresolved risks before they become delivery failures.

Governance and Communication

Establish effective working level and management level governance for every project.
Maintain accurate project plans, schedules, RACI, RAID logs, decision logs and action trackers.
Ensure that project management tools reflect the correct and current status of each project.
Provide concise, factual and transparent status updates, without masking delivery risks or delays.
Prepare and present project status, risks, recovery plans and decisions required to senior management.
Adapt communication according to the audience, from technical teams to business leaders and CXOs.

Continuous Improvement

Manage multiple projects simultaneously and effectively prioritise competing demands.
Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks and recommend improvements to processes, governance and ways of working.
Promote disciplined project-management practices across internal teams and external partners.
Share learning and reusable practices across projects.

Required Skills and Competencies

Strong end to end technology project management experience.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross functional teams without direct authority.
Strong technical understanding of APIs, web services, application platforms and system integrations.
Working knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, Unix/Linux, databases, Java-based applications, Kubernetes and information security.
Ability to understand technical discussions, ask the right questions and challenge engineering teams constructively.
Experience in testing, troubleshooting and debugging APIs and integration issues.
Strong ownership mindset with a bias towards action and resolution.
Assertive communication and the ability to hold stakeholders accountable.
Confidence and executive presence to engage with senior management and CXOs.
Ability to escalate constructively, supported by facts, impact assessment and recommended actions.
Strong problem solving, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Ability to remain effective under pressure and during short delivery timelines.
Strong skills in MS Project, Jira, Confluence, Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to work across diverse cultures, countries and time zones.
Willingness to support critical deployments outside normal business hours and travel at short notice.
Mobile money, payments, fintech, banking or telecommunications experience is preferred.
French language capability would be an advantage.
Agile or SAFe knowledge would be an advantage.

Educational Qualifications and Experience

BE/BTech, MCA, MTech or an equivalent technology-related qualification.
A recognised project-management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent qualification is preferred.
6–10 years of overall experience, including at least 4 years managing technology integration projects.
Experience delivering projects involving engineering teams, business stakeholders, external partners and technology vendors.
Experience in mobile money, digital payments, banking, fintech or telecommunications would be strongly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Description

Job Title:
Contract Senior Intelligence Analyst

Required Security Clearance
: TS/SCI

Location:
National Ground Intelligence Center (NGIC) – Charlottesville, VA

Position Overview

Leidos is seeking a Senior Intelligence Analyst
to serve as the FUSION program’s principal contractor authority for analytic tradecraft, methodology, rigor, and finished‑intelligence quality
. This senior leader will guide analysts in selecting and applying appropriate methods, conduct final contractor reviews prior to Government submission, mentor the analytic workforce, and help integrate AI‑enabled analytic tools
into production while preserving objectivity, transparency, sourcing discipline, and human judgment.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as the senior contractor advisor for analytic tradecraft, methodology, rigor, and finished‑intelligence quality.
Guide analysts in applying structured analytic techniques, quantitative methods, qualitative methods, and advanced analytic tools.
Review contractor intelligence products prior to Government review to ensure they fully address customer requirements.
Train and mentor analysts on analytic standards, production processes, and effective human‑machine teaming.
Evaluate and guide responsible use of AI—including generative AI—in analytic research, production, and quality control in accordance with U.S. Government policy.

Specific Duties

Participate in project kickoffs, analytic design reviews, and in‑progress reviews to establish sound methodology throughout the product lifecycle.
Review analytical design worksheets and advise analysts on methods, assumptions, sourcing, and limitations.
Track contractor finished‑intelligence production and identify risks to quality, schedule, or customer responsiveness.
Conduct final contractor review for grammar, clarity, logic, sourcing, classification, metadata, analytic standards, and compliance with the NGIC Product Review Guide.
Assess whether intelligence products clearly answer customer questions and distinguish facts, assumptions, judgments, and uncertainty.
Provide training, coaching, and mentorship to new and experienced analysts.
Serve as the contractor technical representative for tradecraft, methodology, analytic quality, and assessment production.
Evaluate AI‑assisted analytic approaches for suitability, transparency, bias, reliability, sourcing, and security.
Ensure AI‑generated or AI‑assisted content is validated by qualified analysts and complies with ICD 203, ICD 206, classification guidance, and Government policy.

Basic Qualifications

Current Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility at time of hire.
Ability to work full‑time on‑site at NGIC in Charlottesville, VA, beginning Day 1.
Ability to comply with all security, intelligence‑oversight, information‑handling, and training requirements.
Master’s degree in intelligence studies, national security, international affairs, data analytics, or related field.
Twenty (20) years of progressively responsible intelligence‑analysis experience supporting DoD or IC missions.
Minimum five (5) years serving as a senior intelligence analyst, analytic methodologist, tradecraft lead, branch‑level reviewer, or equivalent analytic leader.
Extensive experience producing and reviewing all‑source finished intelligence.
Demonstrated expertise applying IC analytic standards, structured analytic techniques, and appropriate quantitative/qualitative methods.
Experience mentoring analysts and conducting formal product reviews for rigor, sourcing, classification, and customer relevance.
Strong working knowledge or training in AI‑enabled analytic tools, generative AI, data analytics, or human‑machine teaming.

Preferred Qualifications

Certified Defense All‑Source Analysis – Intelligence (CDASA‑I).
Intelligence Fundamentals Professional Certification (IFPC) or comparable IC credential.
Experience supporting NGIC, INSCOM, DIA, Army G‑2, or other Defense Intelligence Enterprise organizations.
Experience serving as a Government or contractor Senior Intelligence Analyst, analytic methodologist, tradecraft lead, analytic ombudsman, or product‑quality evaluator.
Experience reviewing products against ICD 203, ICD 206, and agency‑specific production guides.

new_jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Black Lotus Labs has an opening for a Lead Information Security Engineer who will support threat hunting, investigation, and discovery of evolving malicious activity using Lumen’s unique network visibility, analytic platforms, and approved AI-enabled tools. Our global visibility into one of the world’s largest and most interconnected IP backbones, combined with our computing cluster and analytic platforms, presents exciting opportunities to apply machine learning, graph analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to help identify threats across the internet. Black Lotus Labs has detected and disrupted key evolving threats at an internet scale for years.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Join our Business Intelligence team, where data is transformed into insights that drive business performance and strategic decisions. You'll work with data from multiple sources, partnering with stakeholders across the business to define meaningful KPIs, build and maintain Tableau dashboards, and use SQL to uncover trends, validate data, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will directly influence decision-making, helping teams better understand performance, identify new opportunities, and continuously improve the way we use data to grow the business. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy turning complex data into clear, impactful solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Core responsibilities

Use SQL to extract, transform, and manage data from internal sources, ensuring it’s accurate and ready for analysis.
Analyze complex business problems, uncovering trends, root causes, and opportunities to improve performance.
Build and enhance Tableau reports and dashboards, turning data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
Partner with product, management, and cross-functional teams to define KPIs and support data-driven decision-making.
Collaborate closely with BI teammates and data engineers to improve data pipelines, reduce technical debt, and scale the Data Warehouse.
Proactively explore data beyond assigned requests. Anticipate surface trends, risks, and opportunities to bring insights before issues arise.

Experience and key competencies

At least 2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar analytical role, supported by a relevant educational background (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field).
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming, and validating large datasets, writing complex queries, and optimizing performance. Knowledge of Python or R is an advantage.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau (or a similar BI tool), with the ability to present complex data in a clear and actionable way.
Solid understanding of data modeling, KPI design, metrics documentation, and statistical methods, with the ability to apply them to real business challenges.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively.
Analytical mindset with the ability to balance attention to detail while keeping the bigger picture in focus.
Self-driven and adaptable, with strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Fluency in verbal and written communication in English is essential, as it's our primary means of interaction.

Think of this job ad as more of a friendly guide than a rigid 'must-have' list. We're well aware that no one will tick all the boxes, so feel free to apply even if you're not a perfect match – we love close matches too!

Our benefits, Your happiness

Enjoy 28 days of vacation with the option to use your balance on business days only, effectively giving you up to 10 extra days off. Combined with flexible working hours, you can make the most of your time off.
Prioritize your well-being with monthly sports/health compensation, full sick leave coverage for the first 8 days, our in-house gym, and a chill games room to unwind.
Invest in your professional growth with an annual training budget that can be used for courses, certifications, workshops, and learning opportunities relevant to your role.
Our office is a cozy (and dog-friendly) haven right in the heart of the city. Enjoy complimentary fruits and beverages and free parking. It's the perfect place to be productive and feel right at home.
Be part of the most legendary events and make amazing connections with colleagues from across the entire company.
Thrive in a diverse, multicultural environment where innovation and new ideas are welcomed, independence is encouraged, success is celebrated, and you'll have the freedom to make a real impact alongside talented people from across the globe.
..plus, if you're not already a pro, we'll teach you how to play poker!

Samaritan's Purse is seeking an Operations Data Analyst
